title: System Engineer
description:
**Job Summary**

This hybrid day shift role seeks a system engineer with three to four years of experience in console operations mainframes and mainframe API within the telecom domain. The system engineer will maintain highly available production environments optimize mainframe workflows and support telecom specific services to ensure reliable customer connectivity and operational excellence across business critical platforms.

**Responsibilities**

* Monitor telecom production mainframe console activities to ensure stable operations and timely response to system events that impact service continuity for customers
* Analyze system alerts and job failures from mainframe consoles to identify root causes and apply corrective actions that reduce downtime and improve platform reliability
* Configure and maintain mainframe API components to enable secure and efficient integration between telecom applications and core systems for consistent data flows
* Collaborate with application support and network teams to coordinate mainframe changes and deployments that protect service quality and align with telecom business commitments
* Document standard operating procedures for console operations and mainframe workflows to support knowledge sharing and consistent execution across the hybrid work model
* Review performance metrics for telecom mainframe environments to propose tuning adjustments that enhance transaction throughput and reduce latency for end users
* Execute scheduled batch jobs and operational tasks in the day shift window to meet telecom processing deadlines and comply with internal policies and external regulations
* Conduct impact assessments for mainframe configuration updates to prevent service disruption and maintain alignment between technical changes and telecom product roadmaps
* Provide technical support for incidents related to mainframe API integrations by validating request flows and coordinating remediation that protects data integrity
* Coordinate with vendors and internal infrastructure teams to track mainframe software versions and plan upgrades that strengthen security posture and operational resilience
* Maintain accurate records of system changes and incident resolutions to support operational audits and enable continuous improvement of console operations in telecom contexts
* Participate in problem management activities by contributing detailed analysis of recurring mainframe issues and recommending targeted preventive actions for long term stability
* Engage in continuous learning around evolving telecom standards and mainframe practices to suggest pragmatic enhancements that increase efficiency and societal connectivity impact

**Qualifications**

* Possess hands on experience in console operations with three to four years of focused work managing system events and batch processing in complex enterprise environments
* Demonstrate strong proficiency in mainframes including job control concepts resource usage analysis and performance tuning within production grade settings
* Apply practical knowledge of mainframe API usage by designing and supporting integrations that connect telecom applications with core mainframe services in a secure manner
* Bring solid telecom domain experience that enables accurate interpretation of operational priorities service level expectations and customer impact across network driven offerings
* Work effectively in a hybrid model by balancing onsite collaboration and remote focus work while maintaining clear communication and reliable availability during day shifts
* Show capability to follow structured incident and change management practices that align with organizational standards and promote stable mainframe service delivery
* Exhibit analytical problem solving skills with attention to detail when assessing console logs and system metrics to propose realistic solutions that improve operational outcomes

title: NOC Engineer
description:
Blink Charging Co. (Nasdaq: BLNK) is a leading owner, operator, and provider of electric vehicle (EV) charging equipment and networked EV charging services. We're on a mission to accelerate the adoption of electric vehicles by deploying thousands of charging stations across the United States and around the world.

**What We Do:**

Blink offers both residential and commercial EV charging equipment and connectivity to the Blink Network—a comprehensive cloud-based software that operates, manages, and tracks our EV charging stations and payment processing. Our charging solutions serve a diverse range of customers including multi-family residential and commercial properties, airports, colleges, municipalities, parking garages, shopping malls, retail parking, and more.

**Why Blink:**

* **Industry Leader:** We're at the forefront of the EV charging revolution, building critical infrastructure for a sustainable future
* **Innovation-Driven:** We continuously develop cutting-edge technology to improve the EV charging experience
* **Growth Opportunity:** Join a rapidly expanding company in one of the world's fastest-growing industries
* **Mission That Matters:** Every day, we're helping reduce carbon emissions and create a cleaner planet

**Position Summary**
====================

The NOC Engineer monitors and remotely diagnoses networked EV charging equipment across multiple charger models, manufacturers, customers, and regions. The role converts incomplete or ambiguous reports into defined technical conditions, evaluates likely failure domains, performs approved remote actions, and either resolves the issue or produces a complete technical escalation.

This is an investigative technical role, not a script-driven support position. Success requires strong diagnostic reasoning, comfort working across hardware and software systems, and the judgment to distinguish charger faults from site power, connectivity, configuration, payment, backend, or field-service issues.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* **Monitoring and incident response:** Monitor charger availability, connectivity, faults, transaction activity, authorization failures, energy delivery, and station-health trends. Prioritize incidents based on safety, customer impact, ownership, service status, and business risk.
* **Remote diagnostics:** Define the observable symptom and affected scope; form and rank likely causes; analyze logs, sessions, connectivity, configuration, firmware, fault history, audit history, and prior cases; perform approved resets, retrievals, updates, or configuration actions; validate the outcome.
* **Commissioning support:** Validate asset records, provisioning, network enrollment, OCPP endpoint settings, SIM/APN and modem status, approved firmware, payment-terminal readiness, and successful authorization and charging tests for applicable Level 2 and DC fast chargers.
* **Technical escalation:** Route issues to the correct OEM, Engineering, Development, Field Services, installer, electrician, payment provider, or connectivity provider. Include the symptom, scope, evidence, tests, results, likely failure domain, unresolved questions, and requested action.
* **Case management:** Maintain Salesforce as the authoritative technical record. Document work performed, evidence reviewed, results, dependencies, owner, next step, and follow-up date. Identify duplicate or related cases and preserve clear handoffs.
* **Safety and boundaries:** Recognize unsafe conditions, take approved steps to make equipment inoperative, and route physical electrical or repair work to qualified resources. Avoid unsupported firmware or configuration changes.

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot technical systems by forming hypotheses, selecting tests, interpreting evidence, and narrowing the likely cause.
* Working knowledge of IP networking concepts, including connectivity, TCP/IP, DNS, URLs, cellular communications, SIMs, APNs, VPNs, and remote-device access.
* Working understanding of electrical fundamentals relevant to EV charging, including voltage, current, power, breaker capacity, grounding, phases, load management, and upstream site infrastructure.
* Ability to interpret logs, timestamps, system states, event sequences, transaction records, configuration values, and historical trends.
* Strong written documentation and concise technical communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively across multiple platforms, global teams, and external technical partners.
* Professional-level written and spoken English and ability to work the assigned overnight schedule.

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* Experience supporting EVSE, distributed energy systems, industrial controls, telecommunications, IoT devices, payment terminals, or other remotely managed field equipment.
* Experience with OCPP 1.6 or later and common message flows such as BootNotification, StatusNotification, Authorize, StartTransaction, StopTransaction, MeterValues, configuration retrieval, and remote reset.
* Experience with AC Level 2 and DC fast-charging systems, Salesforce, Grafana or similar monitoring tools, Linux, SSH, VPNs, firmware management, and structured log analysis.
* Experience coordinating investigations with OEMs, field technicians, electricians, Engineering, or software-development teams.
* Technical degree, certification, or equivalent practical experience in electrical engineering, electronics, computer science, IT, networking, telecommunications, mechatronics, or a related discipline.

**Experience and Education**
============================

* A four-year degree is preferred, not required.
* Equivalent experience in network operations, field engineering, industrial equipment, telecommunications, technical support, or complex hardware/software troubleshooting should be accepted.
* Two or more years of relevant technical troubleshooting experience is preferred. Direct EVSE experience is valuable but should not replace demonstrated diagnostic capability.

**Measures of Success**
=======================

* Independently conduct a structured station-health assessment.
* Distinguish among charger, site-power, connectivity, configuration, payment, backend, and customer-related failure domains.
* Resolve approved remote issues without unnecessary dispatch or escalation.
* Produce complete cases and technically actionable escalations.
* Demonstrate proficiency across assigned charger families and operational portals.
* Contribute recurring findings to SOPs, playbooks, and knowledge-base content.

**Work Schedule**
=================

**Assigned shift (range): 8:30 p.m. to 5:30 a.m. or 11:30 p.m. to 8:30 a.m. IST.** Holidays are conditional on business needs, or as otherwise assigned by the organization.

title: Director - Security Architecture & Solution Engineering - Network & Zero Trust Architecture
description:
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Domain focus: Network & Zero Trust Architecture; domain authority across a large enterprise estate.**

**Job Purpose:**

  

Own the Network and Zero Trust domain as design authority for GSK. Zero Trust is a current Cyber Architecture and Solutions priority being built from the ground up rather than maintained, so this role is designing where GSK has no incumbent framework. A two-person domain: you and one Principal Architectyou and one Senior Principal Architect, with no engineering function of your own — Security Solution Engineering builds to your specifications and a managed service vendor operates the result.

**About the team**:

Security Architecture and Solution Engineering sets the target-state security architecture for GSK and builds the solutions that realise it. The function brings IT and OT architecture under single ownership for the first time, spanning Network and Zero Trust, Application Security, Platform Security, MDR and Detection Engineering, VM and Configuration Management, Data Security, and OT Security across a global manufacturing, laboratory and research estate. Architecture sets the standards and reference designs, Solution Engineering builds, tests and packages them, and a managed service vendor operates them. Architecture accountability never transfers: Cyber Architecture and Solutions designs and builds, the vendor runs. Twenty roles, with standards applying in more than 100 countries.

**What makes this role different.** You are building a Zero Trust framework from nothing, not operating one someone else designed. This is a design authority role with a very small team: one Principal Architectvery small team: one Senior Principal Architect, no engineering function of your own — Solution Engineering builds what you specify and the vendor operates it. If you need a large team or direct control of implementation to be effective, you will find this frustrating. Expect to be asked what failed in a Zero Trust programme you ran, not just what you designed.

**Key responsibilities:**

This role will provide you the opportunity to lead key activities to progress your career. These responsibilities include some of the following:

  

* Act as design authority for Network and Zero Trust architecture across GSK.
* Own the Zero Trust policy framework: device trust, identity trust and application access policy.
* Own network segmentation and microsegmentation standards across the estate.
* Own SASE and SD-WAN security architecture, secure remote access design and DNS security architecture.
* Produce architecture specifications that Solution Engineering builds from without reinterpretation.
* Maintain the Network and Zero Trust reference architecture library.
* Reject network and Zero Trust tooling that cannot express policy as code, integrate with the existing identity provider, or be operated by the managed service without Cyber Architecture and Solutions present.
* Assure the handover pack for every Zero Trust enforcement point and segmentation policy change before the vendor takes it, and retain the architecture decision when they propose a workaround in production.
* Resolve the segmentation boundary with OT Security where Purdue Level 3.5 meets the corporate network, and with Platform Security where NAC posture checks depend on EDR health.

title: Non-Functional Test Engineer
description:
**Job Summary**

Non Functional Test Engineer role in a hybrid work model for an airport operations and airlines domain project focusing on performance reliability and resilience testing for critical aviation applications. The engineer will design and execute non functional test strategies using automation AI test generation tools and API testing to ensure high quality systems that support safe and efficient air travel operations across global stakeholders.

**Responsibilities**

* Define comprehensive non functional test strategies and plans that validate performance reliability scalability and security of airport operations and airline applications in alignment with business goals and regulatory expectations.
* Design detailed test scenarios using advanced AI test generation tools to increase coverage reduce human error and accelerate identification of bottlenecks across complex aviation workflows.
* Develop robust automated test suites for performance and resilience including load stress endurance and capacity tests that provide clear metrics on system behavior under realistic airport passenger and flight volumes.
* Implement API testing frameworks that validate response time throughput data consistency and error handling for critical integrations among booking systems airport operational control systems and airline services.
* Coordinate end to end non functional test execution in a hybrid work model ensuring smooth collaboration between onsite and remote stakeholders and maintaining consistent communication and documentation.
* Analyze performance test results using structured methods to identify root causes of latency resource contention and stability issues and translate findings into practical tuning recommendations for engineering teams.
* Collaborate closely with application architects and developers to define non functional requirements capacity targets and service level objectives that reflect real world airline and airport operational demands.
* Create clear reusable test data strategies for non functional testing that simulate flight schedules passenger profiles baggage volumes and operational events without compromising privacy or compliance.
* Prepare concise dashboards and reports that present key non functional quality indicators trends and risks to project managers product owners and domain experts enabling informed decision making.
* Establish and refine automation standards for non functional tests to improve repeatability maintainability and integration into continuous integration and delivery pipelines across aviation platforms.
* Validate system behavior under failure scenarios by orchestrating component outages network disruptions and degraded services to ensure graceful recovery and minimal impact on airport and airline operations.
* Support defect triage for non functional issues by prioritizing based on customer impact operational risk and regulatory considerations and by driving timely resolution with technical teams.
* Mentor peers on non functional testing practices tools and domain specific scenarios sharing knowledge about aviation processes so the entire team can deliver higher reliability outcomes.

**Qualifications**

* Demonstrate strong experience in using AI test generation tools to design complex non functional test scenarios enhancing coverage and reducing test design cycle time in fast paced delivery environments.
* Apply practical expertise in test automation frameworks to create maintain and execute performance and reliability test suites that integrate seamlessly with existing build and deployment pipelines.
* Use deep hands on skills in API testing to validate functional and non functional aspects of services including response time throughput error handling and security behavior for aviation integrations.
* Bring proven domain experience in airport operations encompassing passenger handling flight turnaround baggage operations and resource allocation to design realistic performance test scenarios.
* Exhibit solid understanding of airline business processes such as reservations ticketing check in boarding disruption management and loyalty programs to align non functional testing with actual use cases.
* Possess strong analytical abilities in interpreting performance metrics logs and traces enabling quick isolation of capacity constraints configuration issues and architectural limitations.
* Show capability to work effectively in a hybrid model managing time collaboration tools and documentation practices to maintain transparency and continuity across distributed teams.
* Maintain familiarity with industry standards and good practices related to non functional quality performance security and reliability in mission critical transportation and travel systems.

title: Software Development Manager, Just Walk Out
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Lead a new India-based embedded and firmware engineering team for Just Walk Out's edge devices: the cameras, sensors, RFID, gates and networking hardware in our stores, and the device-side software that connects them to the cloud. This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You'll manage 8-12 engineers, set technical direction across firmware, embedded Linux and embedded Android, and partner closely with the US engineering team that owns this charter today.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Hire, coach and develop a high-judgment team of embedded, firmware and edge software engineers, and build an inclusive, high-ownership culture as the team grows in India
* Own the technical roadmap, delivery and operational excellence for your team's firmware and embedded software, from requirements and architecture through release and field support
* Set engineering standards across the embedded stack: firmware and RTOS/bare-metal code, embedded Linux and Android, drivers and board bring-up, secure boot and OTA updates, and on-device diagnostics
* Own the device-to-cloud boundary with cloud teams: provisioning and identity, connectivity, telemetry and remote management, including the device's AWS IoT / embedded-Linux connectivity stack
* Build the test infrastructure, staged rollouts and telemetry needed to ship firmware safely across a large fleet of deployed devices
* Lead the response to field issues, telling firmware from hardware, connectivity or sensor faults, and drive root cause and lasting fixes
* Drive execution with the US engineering team, product and program management, hardware/ODM partners, and cloud, data and UI/UX teams across time zones

  
A day in the life  
You might start with 1:1s and a design review, helping an engineer reason through an OTA rollback path or a latency budget on a constrained target. Later you agree scope for the next release with product and the US partner team, and re-plan the sprint because a hardware revision changed what's possible. In the afternoon you join your engineers on a field issue affecting a few devices at one store, get them the telemetry and a plan, and keep the fix moving.  
  
About the team  
Just Walk Out builds the technology behind checkout-free shopping: the devices, networking and cloud software that let shoppers walk out without stopping to pay. . This India team will take direct ownership of part of that charter, working closely with the US engineering team, hardware partners and the operations teams who rely on what we ship.  
  
About AWS:  
  
Diverse Experiences: AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job below, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  
  
Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  
  
Inclusive Team Culture - Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth - We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.  
  
Work/Life Balance - We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of engineering team management experience
* Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
* Experience partnering with product or program management teams
* Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
* 7+ years of software engineering experience, including embedded systems or firmware development
* Experience leading the development of embedded, real-time, or hardware-interfacing systems delivered on physical hardware

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
* Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers
* Hands-on embedded Linux (including Yocto) and/or embedded Android, with Linux kernel or driver development and low-level debugging
* Sustaining a large fleet of deployed devices: OTA firmware updates, telemetry, and remote diagnostics at scale
* Experience at the device-to-cloud boundary (connectivity, provisioning, fleet management), ideally with AWS IoT / Greengrass and MQTT
* Depth in Android/Linux firmware, secure boot, wireless connectivity, or RFID/sensor devices, plus hardware-in-the-loop testing

title: Subject Matter Expert (Support&Ops)
description:
**Job Summary**
---------------

The Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) L3 Support Engineer provides advanced technical support and operational ownership for enterprise AVD environments. The role resolves complex escalations from L1/L2 teams, performs root cause analysis, and maintains the availability, performance, security, and scalability of virtual desktops and published applications. The engineer manages session hosts, images, user profiles, monitoring, and automation while coordinating with cloud, identity, network, storage, security, and application teams to improve service reliability and end-user experience.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

Own complex AVD incidents escalated by L1/L2 teams, including connection failures, session disconnections, slow sign-in, profile failures, application issues, and degraded desktop performance. • Administer and troubleshoot host pools, session hosts, application groups, workspaces, desktop assignments, RemoteApp publishing, and session host registration. • Manage FSLogix profile containers and associated storage dependencies; investigate profile attachment failures, permissions, capacity, latency, and profile corruption using approved recovery procedures. • Maintain standardized session host images, application configurations, patching, image versioning, testing, controlled rollout, and rollback readiness. • Analyze resource utilization, session density, load balancing, scaling plans, and virtual machine sizing to improve performance and cost efficiency within agreed service requirements. • Use Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, AVD Insights, event logs, and diagnostic data to identify service degradation, investigate incidents, and improve alerting. • Troubleshoot identity, authentication, Group Policy, DNS, network connectivity, and storage access issues in coordination with the responsible platform teams. • Develop and maintain PowerShell automation for repeatable administration, health checks, reporting, and operational remediation, with appropriate testing and change approval. • Lead technical investigation during major incidents, provide clear restoration updates, document root causes, and track corrective and preventive actions. • Implement approved changes with impact assessments, validation plans, maintenance coordination, and rollback procedures. • Support security hardening, least-privilege access, vulnerability remediation, audit evidence, and recovery testing in collaboration with security and cloud teams. • Maintain runbooks, architecture records, troubleshooting guides, and knowledge articles; provide technical guidance and knowledge transfer to L1/L2 support teams.

**Skill Requirements**
----------------------

AVD expertise: Strong hands-on experience administering and troubleshooting pooled and personal host pools, session hosts, application groups, workspaces, RemoteApp, load balancing, and scaling plans. • Windows and application support: Advanced troubleshooting of Windows desktop and multi-session environments, Microsoft 365 applications, application compatibility, policies, services, and operating system performance. • Profile and storage management: Practical expertise in FSLogix, profile containers, Azure Files or equivalent supported profile storage, access permissions, and storage performance diagnostics. • Azure infrastructure: Working knowledge of Azure virtual machines, virtual networks, network security groups, DNS, routing, storage, Azure Compute Gallery, and resource management. • Identity and security: Understanding of Active Directory Domain Services, Microsoft Entra ID, supported device join models, role-based access control, multifactor authentication, and Conditional Access dependencies. • Monitoring and diagnostics: Ability to correlate AVD diagnostics, Windows event logs, Azure Monitor metrics, and Log Analytics data; working knowledge of Kusto Query Language (KQL). • Automation: Strong PowerShell scripting skills; familiarity with Azure CLI and infrastructure-as-code tools such as Bicep or Terraform is desirable. • Endpoint and image management: Experience with image lifecycle management, patch deployment, application delivery, and tools such as Microsoft Intune or Configuration Manager where applicable. • Service management: Strong incident, problem, change, and major incident management practices, including evidence-based root cause analysis and service-level awareness. • Communication: Clear spoken and written English, concise technical documentation, and the ability to explain business impact, recovery progress, and technical recommendations to stakeholders

**Must Have Skill**
-------------------

Citrix Virtual Desktops Essentials

**Good to Have Skill**
----------------------

**Other Requirements**
----------------------

Education: Relevant qualification in information technology, computer science, engineering, or equivalent practical experience. • Experience: Demonstrated enterprise virtual desktop support experience, including hands-on AVD administration and independent resolution of L3-level escalations. The required number of years should be confirmed against the hiring grade. • Preferred certification: Microsoft Certified: Azure Virtual Desktop Specialty (AZ-140); Azure administration and ITIL certifications are additional advantages, subject to hiring requirements. • Support coverage: Availability for agreed rotational shifts, on-call support, major incident response, and planned maintenance outside normal business hours. • Work arrangement: Ability to meet the designated work location, onsite/hybrid/remote model, and client support time-zone requirements. • Operational discipline: Compliance with change approvals, information security procedures, confidentiality requirements, and accurate ticket and configuration documentation. • Collaboration: Ability to work effectively with distributed support teams, platform specialists, application owners, and vendor support. Include scenario-based technical assessments covering AVD connection failures, slow sign-in, FSLogix profile issues, session host performance, and scaling-related incidents.\\\\r\\\\n• Assess practical PowerShell and diagnostic skills through a controlled exercise using sample logs or a non-production environment.\\\\r\\\\n• Request examples of complex incident resolution, root cause analysis, image deployment, automation, and service improvement without disclosure of confidential client information.\\\\r\\\\n• Consider experience with enterprise AVD deployments, migrations from traditional VDI, recovery testing, and infrastructure-as-code as desirable.\\\\r\\\\n• Confirm the hiring grade, experience range, work location, employment type, shift/on-call pattern, environment scale, and account-specific tools before publication.\\\\r\\\\n• Define first-90-day expectations covering environment familiarization, independent escalation handling, runbook improvements, and an agreed reliability or automation improvement.\\\\r\\\\n\\\\r\\\\n

title: Staff Cloud Services Engineer
description:
**Job Title – Staff Cloud Service Engineer III (Microsoft 365 Email Security & SMTP)** **Role Overview**

We are seeking an experienced Email Security & Microsoft 365 Messaging Engineer to own engineering, operation and continuous improvement of enterprise email platform, mail flow and email security services across a global estate. This is a hands-on technical role for a professional who can take ownership of complex incidents and engineering work, not an entry-level or developmental position.

The successful candidate will manage, evolve, support Exchange Online, Microsoft Defender for Office 365, Microsoft Purview, Cisco secure email gateways, SMTP relay services Public DNS configuration and hygiene adhering to industry standards. They will work with security, identity, network and application teams, and with suppliers, to keep email secure, deliverable, compliant and reliable.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage the configuration of Cisco secure email gateways, including inbound and outbound routing, policies, quarantine and encryption.
* Design, manage and troubleshoot Exchange Online services, including transport rules, connectors, accepted and remote domains, mailbox and distribution group settings, and migrations.
* Design, configure and optimize Microsoft Defender for Office 365 policies, including anti-spam, anti-phishing with impersonation protection, anti-malware, Safe Links, Safe Attachments and pre-set security policies.
* Own email authentication for all company domains: SPF, DKIM, DMARC
* Design and support SMTP relay and application email services
* Onboard and govern applications, devices (such as multifunction printers and scanners) and SaaS platforms that send email on behalf of company domains, making sure they are authenticated, approved and documented.
* Investigate and remediate phishing, business email compromise, spoofing and malware campaigns with the Security Operations team, using Threat Explorer, message trace, Advanced Hunting and automated investigation and response.
* Monitor mail flow health, deliverability, queue and reputation issues, using Exchange Admin Centre, Defender portal, message trace, Microsoft 365 Service Health and gateway reporting.
* Support Microsoft Purview controls that apply to email: data loss prevention, sensitivity labels, message encryption, retention, eDiscovery and journaling.
* Use ServiceNow and Jira to manage incidents, requests, problems, changes and project activities in line with operational processes.
* Create and maintain designs, runbooks, mail flow diagrams, standards, domain and sender inventories, and knowledge articles.
* Provide clear technical guidance and knowledge transfer to service desk teams, application owners and other engineers.

**Role Scope & Technical Ownership**

This is an experienced engineering role responsible for independently handling complex work, making sound operational decisions and contributing to the technical direction of messaging and email security. It includes broad technical ownership across:

* SMTP relay services for applications, devices and third-party platforms.
* Exchange Online, and mail flow architecture, including routing through secure email gateways.
* Microsoft Defender for Office 365 and the wider email threat protection stack.
* Domain and sender governance: SPF, DKIM, DMARC enforcement and the inventory of approved senders.
* Email-related identity and access controls, including Conditional Access, modern authentication and the removal of legacy protocols.
* Email data protection and compliance with Microsoft Purview.
* Technical leadership during email incidents, including deciding when to block, quarantine, reroute, roll back a change, escalate or engage a specialist.
* Global service delivery, Incident, Change and Problem Management, root-cause analysis and preventative actions.
* Automation with PowerShell (Exchange Online, Microsoft Graph), Power Automate and Logic Apps to improve operations and reporting.
* Mentoring less-experienced engineers and service desk teams.

**Skills & Experience** **Exchange Online & Messaging**

* Hands-on professional experience engineering and supporting Exchange Online in a large enterprise.
* Strong knowledge of mail flow: connectors, transport rules, accepted domains, centralized mail transport, and routing through third-party gateways.
* Experience with mailbox types, shared and resource mailboxes, distribution and Microsoft 365 groups, permissions and migrations.
* Confident use of message trace, Exchange Admin Centre, Microsoft 365 Service Health and Microsoft support escalation.

**Email Security**

* Practical experience configuring and tuning Microsoft Defender for Office 365
* Experience administering secure email gateway
* Detailed understanding of SPF, DKIM, DMARC, ARC, MTA-STS and TLS, and experience moving domains to DMARC enforcement.
* Experience investigating phishing, spoofing and business email compromise with Security Operations teams.
* Working knowledge of email encryption, data loss prevention and sensitivity labels in Microsoft Purview.

**SMTP & Application Email**

* Deep understanding of SMTP: the protocol, headers, response codes, TLS negotiation, MX and DNS records, and bounce (NDR) analysis.
* Experience designing and supporting SMTP relay for applications and devices, including authenticated submission, connector-based relay and third-party relay services.
* Experience planning and delivering the retirement of Basic Authentication and legacy SMTP AUTH.
* Ability to diagnose deliverability problems blocklists, IP and domain reputation, throttling, and recipient-side rejections.

**Identity, Automation & Operations**

* Working knowledge of Entra ID, Conditional Access, modern authentication and licensing as they apply to messaging.
* Strong PowerShell skills (Exchange Online module, Microsoft Graph); experience with Power Automate or Logic Apps is desirable.
* Working understanding of DNS, firewalls, proxies and TLS certificates.
* Strong systematic troubleshooting: restore service first, then complete root-cause analysis.
* Experience managing incidents and changes through ServiceNow or a comparable IT service management platform.

**Communication & Customer Support**

* Ability to explain technical issues clearly to the audience and give concise, actionable updates.
* Comfortable working under time pressure, for example during an active phishing campaign, while keeping sound judgement.
* Professional written and spoken English suitable for global engineering, security and business teams.

**Personal Attributes**

* Accountable: owns technical issues from first diagnosis through restoration, escalation and closure.
* Security-minded: balances protection against deliverability and user experience, and document why each decision was made.
* Calm, methodical and decisive during live incidents such as phishing campaigns or mail flow outages.
* Curious and committed to keeping up with changes in Microsoft 365, email standards and the threat landscape.
* Confident making recommendations, and comfortable admitting knowledge gaps and bringing in specialists.
* Collaborative and non-territorial, working well with security, identity, network and application teams.
* Organized and detail-oriented, with a commitment to documentation, standards, change control and knowledge transfer.
* Respectful and constructively challenging, able to push back on risky sender or relay requests without undermining colleagues.
* Comfortable working independently while staying connected to a globally distributed team.

**Desired Overall Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate is a strong messaging engineer who understands email end to end from SMTP and DNS on the wire, through Exchange Online and the security stack, to the people and applications that depend on it. They are neither only an Exchange administrator nor only a security analyst.

They do not need expert knowledge of every product. More important is the breadth to understand how mail flow, security controls, identity and DNS interact, to isolate the likely fault quickly, and to engage the right specialists when needed.

Hands-on Exchange Online and email security experience, strong SMTP troubleshooting, calm decision-making, clear communication and the ability to work at an experienced engineering level within a collaborative global team are essential.

**Desirable Qualifications & Vendor Experience**

* Microsoft 365 Certified: Messaging Administrator Associate, or equivalent experience.
* Microsoft Certified: Security Operations Analyst Associate (SC-200) or Information Protection Administrator Associate (SC-400).
* Vendor training or certification from Proofpoint, Mimecast, Egress or a similar email security provider.
* Experience with DMARC reporting platforms.
* Experience in a large enterprise with many domains, business units or acquired companies.
* Experience supporting mergers, acquisitions or divestments: domain migration, coexistence and mail routing during transition.
* ITIL Foundation or equivalent service management knowledge.

**Who we are:**

At Pearson, our purpose is simple: to help people realize the life they imagine through learning. We believe that every learning opportunity is a chance for a personal breakthrough. We are the world's lifelong learning company. For us, learning isn't just what we do. It's who we are. To learn more: We are Pearson.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status or any other group protected by law. We actively seek qualified candidates who are protected veterans and individuals with disabilities as defined under VEVRAA and Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act.

If you are an individual with a disability and are unable or limited in your ability to use or access our career site as a result of your disability, you may request reasonable accommodations by emailing TalentExperienceGlobalTeam@grp.pearson.com.

The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in VMware technologies, enterprise backup solutions, storage infrastructure, virtualization lifecycle management, disaster recovery, and infrastructure troubleshooting. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver reliable, secure, and scalable virtualization services while maintaining high operational standards.

Key Responsibilities

* Administer VMware vSphere and related virtualization platforms, including clusters, hosts, virtual machines, templates, host profiles, vMotion, resource allocation, lifecycle management, and platform licensing.

* Design and execute migration and onboarding strategies for customer workloads and internal platforms, including discovery, dependency validation, testing, cutover, rollback planning, and post-migration stabilization.

We are looking for an experienced Civil, Structures and Pipeline engineers with a strong background in the Water and Wastewater industry to support the delivery of major infrastructure and non-Infrastructure projects and utility frameworks. Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career.

title: Architect
description:
**Role Summary**

The Citrix Architect is the technical authority for the organization's Citrix virtualization platform. This role investigates complex, high-severity issues, leads upgrade and migration projects (CVAD and Citrix DaaS), drives the Citrix Profile Management (UPM) vs FSLogix strategy, and evaluates and proves out new solutions through POCs before leading their production deployment.

**Key Duties and Responsibilities**

**1. Architecture and Design**

· Design, document, and maintain the end-to-end Citrix architecture (CVAD on-prem, Citrix DaaS, hybrid, and multi-site/DR designs).

· Produce high-level and low-level designs (HLD/LLD), reference architectures, standards, and build guides.

· Define capacity planning, sizing, scalability, and high-availability strategies for Delivery Controllers, StoreFront, NetScaler/ADC, Cloud Connectors, and VDA workloads.

· Design secure remote access using NetScaler Gateway/ADC, including authentication (SAML, MFA, Entra ID), aligned with Zero Trust principles.

· Ensure the architecture aligns with security, compliance, and enterprise standards.

**2. Complex Issue Investigation and Escalation**

· Serve as the Tier 3 / final technical escalation point for complex, high-impact Citrix incidents.

· Perform deep-dive root cause analysis (RCA) on slow logons, session launch failures, black screens, session reliability/reconnects, HDX/graphics performance, VDA registration failures, and profile issues.

· Use tools such as CDF Control, Citrix Director, WEM analytics, Wireshark, ProcMon, Event Logs, and Citrix Scout to diagnose problems.

· Engage Citrix Support and vendors (Microsoft, hypervisor, storage, network) and drive cases to resolution.

· Document RCA findings, implement permanent fixes, and create knowledge base articles and runbooks.

**3. Upgrade and Project Delivery**

· Lead end-to-end delivery of CVAD upgrades (LTSR/CR): assessment, prerequisites, test plan, pilot, cutover, and rollback planning.

· Lead Citrix DaaS migration, upgrade, or onboarding projects, including Cloud Connector deployment and hybrid/cloud transition.

· Upgrade related components: StoreFront, NetScaler/ADC, Licensing Server, Director, WEM, PVS/MCS, and VDA/master images.

· Develop project plans, timelines, risk registers, and communication plans; coordinate with Project Managers, infrastructure, security, and application teams.

· Ensure minimal downtime and sound change management (CAB, change records, post-implementation reviews).

**4. Profile Management Strategy (UPM vs FSLogix)**

· Evaluate Citrix Profile Management (UPM) vs Microsoft FSLogix on logon performance, scalability, storage impact, resilience, Office/OneDrive/Teams support, and supportability.

· Design the profile architecture: storage (SMB, NetApp, Azure Files), Cloud Cache vs VHD(X) locations, redirection, and exclusions.

· Lead profile migration projects, including pilot, tuning, and user acceptance testing.

· Define best practices for profile size, antivirus exclusions, and monitoring.

**5. New Solution Deployment and POC**

· Lead POCs and pilots for new technologies (e.g., Citrix DaaS, WEM, App Layering, Citrix Analytics, cloud-hosted VDAs, GPU/HDX 3D Pro, Windows 11 multi-session, Citrix Secure Private Access).

· Define success criteria, test cases, and measurable outcomes; present findings with clear recommendations, cost, and risk analysis.

· Lead production rollout of approved solutions through design, build, testing, and handover to operations.

· Evaluate alternatives (e.g., Azure Virtual Desktop, VMware Horizon) and provide objective comparisons when required.

**6. Operations, Automation, and Optimization**

· Optimize logon times, session performance, user experience, and resource utilization.

· Automate deployment, image management, and configuration using PowerShell, REST APIs, Terraform/Ansible, and CI/CD pipelines.

· Define monitoring and alerting strategy (Director, ControlUp, Splunk, SCOM, Azure Monitor, etc.).

· Perform regular health checks, patching strategy reviews, and lifecycle/EOL planning.

· Maintain golden image standards and application delivery/packaging strategy (MSIX, App-V, App Layering).

**7. Governance, Security, and Compliance**

· Define and enforce Citrix security baselines, hardening standards, and certificate management.

· Support audits and vulnerability remediation (NetScaler/ADC patching, Citrix security bulletins).

· Maintain architecture documentation and DR/BCP plans, and test DR failovers.

**8. Leadership and Collaboration**

· Provide technical leadership and mentorship to Citrix engineers and support teams.

· Act as the primary technical liaison with Citrix, Microsoft, and other vendors.

· Communicate technical concepts clearly to stakeholders, management, and non-technical audiences.

· Contribute to roadmap planning, budget inputs, and vendor/licensing strategy.

**9 Methodology Development & Knowledge Transfer**

* Design and continuously refine the team's diagnostic playbook — a step-by-step, tool-by-tool guide that enables engineers at all levels to systematically diagnose logon performance issues in a structured, repeatable way
* Develop training materials, recorded sessions, and runbooks covering the full diagnostic toolchain: Logic Monitor, Citrix Director, Power BI (Citrix All, GPO dashboard, scatter plot), Azure Log Analytics, Wireshark, Citrix policies, and GPO auditing
* Create and maintain a library of "lessons learned” specific, documented findings from customer investigations that can be evaluated and applied across the entire install base
* Mentor Systems Engineers, reviewing their diagnostic approaches, providing guidance on complex cases, and building their technical depth over time
* Conduct knowledge-transfer sessions and training surges so that the team's collective expertise grows faster than any individual's

**10 AI-Assisted Analysis & Tooling**

* Lead the team's use of AI for large-scale analysis — including ingesting Citrix configuration exports, GPO data, ServiceNow knowledge articles, and public Citrix best practice documentation to generate actionable insights and surface configuration gaps at scale
* Develop or guide the development of scripts (PowerShell, Python) to automate GPO auditing, data extraction, and comparison across customer environments
* Work with internal tooling teams to refine and productionize AI-based GPO audit capabilities and Citrix policy analysis pipelines
* Able to work on CITRIX Automation – Can use GitHub for CITRIX innovation

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

· 8–12+ years of experience in end-user computing, with 5+ years in Citrix CVAD architecture and engineering.

· Expert knowledge of Citrix CVAD, Citrix DaaS, StoreFront, NetScaler/ADC, PVS/MCS, Director, and WEM.

· Proven experience delivering major upgrades (CVAD LTSR/CR) and migrations.

· Hands-on experience with UPM and FSLogix, including design, migration, and troubleshooting.

· Strong knowledge of Windows Server/Client, Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, PKI, networking, and storage.

· Experience with hypervisors and cloud platforms (VMware vSphere, Hyper-V, Nutanix AHV, Azure, AWS).

· Proficiency in PowerShell scripting and automation.

· AI-enabled Citrix automation: able to use AI tools to build and troubleshoot PowerShell/REST/Terraform automation for Citrix (image builds, deployments, upgrades, health checks), with GitHub for source control, pull request review, and CI/CD workflows (e.g., GitHub Actions) and the main branch as the controlled, reviewed source of truth.

· Demonstrated ability to lead POCs, solution deployments, and cross-functional projects.

· Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

· Citrix certifications (CCP-V, CCE-V, or current Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops certifications).

· Microsoft certifications (Azure, Windows Server, Microsoft 365).

· Experience with ITIL processes, change management, and Agile/hybrid project delivery.

· Experience with Azure Virtual Desktop or VMware Horizon.

**Key Performance Indicators**

· Reduction in critical incidents and mean time to resolve (MTTR).

· On-time, on-budget delivery of upgrade and migration projects with minimal downtime.

· Improved logon times and user experience metrics.

· POC outcomes delivered with clear, actionable recommendations.

· Quality and completeness of architecture documentation and knowledge transfer.

title: Architect
description:
**Role Summary**

The Citrix Architect is the technical authority for the organization's Citrix virtualization platform. This role investigates complex, high-severity issues, leads upgrade and migration projects (CVAD and Citrix DaaS), drives the Citrix Profile Management (UPM) vs FSLogix strategy, and evaluates and proves out new solutions through POCs before leading their production deployment.

**Key Duties and Responsibilities**

**1. Architecture and Design**

· Design, document, and maintain the end-to-end Citrix architecture (CVAD on-prem, Citrix DaaS, hybrid, and multi-site/DR designs).

· Produce high-level and low-level designs (HLD/LLD), reference architectures, standards, and build guides.

· Define capacity planning, sizing, scalability, and high-availability strategies for Delivery Controllers, StoreFront, NetScaler/ADC, Cloud Connectors, and VDA workloads.

· Design secure remote access using NetScaler Gateway/ADC, including authentication (SAML, MFA, Entra ID), aligned with Zero Trust principles.

· Ensure the architecture aligns with security, compliance, and enterprise standards.

**2. Complex Issue Investigation and Escalation**

· Serve as the Tier 3 / final technical escalation point for complex, high-impact Citrix incidents.

· Perform deep-dive root cause analysis (RCA) on slow logons, session launch failures, black screens, session reliability/reconnects, HDX/graphics performance, VDA registration failures, and profile issues.

· Use tools such as CDF Control, Citrix Director, WEM analytics, Wireshark, ProcMon, Event Logs, and Citrix Scout to diagnose problems.

· Engage Citrix Support and vendors (Microsoft, hypervisor, storage, network) and drive cases to resolution.

· Document RCA findings, implement permanent fixes, and create knowledge base articles and runbooks.

**3. Upgrade and Project Delivery**

· Lead end-to-end delivery of CVAD upgrades (LTSR/CR): assessment, prerequisites, test plan, pilot, cutover, and rollback planning.

· Lead Citrix DaaS migration, upgrade, or onboarding projects, including Cloud Connector deployment and hybrid/cloud transition.

· Upgrade related components: StoreFront, NetScaler/ADC, Licensing Server, Director, WEM, PVS/MCS, and VDA/master images.

· Develop project plans, timelines, risk registers, and communication plans; coordinate with Project Managers, infrastructure, security, and application teams.

· Ensure minimal downtime and sound change management (CAB, change records, post-implementation reviews).

**4. Profile Management Strategy (UPM vs FSLogix)**

· Evaluate Citrix Profile Management (UPM) vs Microsoft FSLogix on logon performance, scalability, storage impact, resilience, Office/OneDrive/Teams support, and supportability.

· Design the profile architecture: storage (SMB, NetApp, Azure Files), Cloud Cache vs VHD(X) locations, redirection, and exclusions.

· Lead profile migration projects, including pilot, tuning, and user acceptance testing.

· Define best practices for profile size, antivirus exclusions, and monitoring.

**5. New Solution Deployment and POC**

· Lead POCs and pilots for new technologies (e.g., Citrix DaaS, WEM, App Layering, Citrix Analytics, cloud-hosted VDAs, GPU/HDX 3D Pro, Windows 11 multi-session, Citrix Secure Private Access).

· Define success criteria, test cases, and measurable outcomes; present findings with clear recommendations, cost, and risk analysis.

· Lead production rollout of approved solutions through design, build, testing, and handover to operations.

· Evaluate alternatives (e.g., Azure Virtual Desktop, VMware Horizon) and provide objective comparisons when required.

**6. Operations, Automation, and Optimization**

· Optimize logon times, session performance, user experience, and resource utilization.

· Automate deployment, image management, and configuration using PowerShell, REST APIs, Terraform/Ansible, and CI/CD pipelines.

· Define monitoring and alerting strategy (Director, ControlUp, Splunk, SCOM, Azure Monitor, etc.).

· Perform regular health checks, patching strategy reviews, and lifecycle/EOL planning.

· Maintain golden image standards and application delivery/packaging strategy (MSIX, App-V, App Layering).

**7. Governance, Security, and Compliance**

· Define and enforce Citrix security baselines, hardening standards, and certificate management.

· Support audits and vulnerability remediation (NetScaler/ADC patching, Citrix security bulletins).

· Maintain architecture documentation and DR/BCP plans, and test DR failovers.

**8. Leadership and Collaboration**

· Provide technical leadership and mentorship to Citrix engineers and support teams.

· Act as the primary technical liaison with Citrix, Microsoft, and other vendors.

· Communicate technical concepts clearly to stakeholders, management, and non-technical audiences.

· Contribute to roadmap planning, budget inputs, and vendor/licensing strategy.

**9 Methodology Development & Knowledge Transfer**

* Design and continuously refine the team's diagnostic playbook — a step-by-step, tool-by-tool guide that enables engineers at all levels to systematically diagnose logon performance issues in a structured, repeatable way
* Develop training materials, recorded sessions, and runbooks covering the full diagnostic toolchain: Logic Monitor, Citrix Director, Power BI (Citrix All, GPO dashboard, scatter plot), Azure Log Analytics, Wireshark, Citrix policies, and GPO auditing
* Create and maintain a library of "lessons learned” specific, documented findings from customer investigations that can be evaluated and applied across the entire install base
* Mentor Systems Engineers, reviewing their diagnostic approaches, providing guidance on complex cases, and building their technical depth over time
* Conduct knowledge-transfer sessions and training surges so that the team's collective expertise grows faster than any individual's

**10 AI-Assisted Analysis & Tooling**

* Lead the team's use of AI for large-scale analysis — including ingesting Citrix configuration exports, GPO data, ServiceNow knowledge articles, and public Citrix best practice documentation to generate actionable insights and surface configuration gaps at scale
* Develop or guide the development of scripts (PowerShell, Python) to automate GPO auditing, data extraction, and comparison across customer environments
* Work with internal tooling teams to refine and productionize AI-based GPO audit capabilities and Citrix policy analysis pipelines
* Able to work on CITRIX Automation – Can use GitHub for CITRIX innovation

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

· 8–12+ years of experience in end-user computing, with 5+ years in Citrix CVAD architecture and engineering.

· Expert knowledge of Citrix CVAD, Citrix DaaS, StoreFront, NetScaler/ADC, PVS/MCS, Director, and WEM.

· Proven experience delivering major upgrades (CVAD LTSR/CR) and migrations.

· Hands-on experience with UPM and FSLogix, including design, migration, and troubleshooting.

· Strong knowledge of Windows Server/Client, Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, PKI, networking, and storage.

· Experience with hypervisors and cloud platforms (VMware vSphere, Hyper-V, Nutanix AHV, Azure, AWS).

· Proficiency in PowerShell scripting and automation.

· AI-enabled Citrix automation: able to use AI tools to build and troubleshoot PowerShell/REST/Terraform automation for Citrix (image builds, deployments, upgrades, health checks), with GitHub for source control, pull request review, and CI/CD workflows (e.g., GitHub Actions) and the main branch as the controlled, reviewed source of truth.

· Demonstrated ability to lead POCs, solution deployments, and cross-functional projects.

· Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

· Citrix certifications (CCP-V, CCE-V, or current Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops certifications).

· Microsoft certifications (Azure, Windows Server, Microsoft 365).

· Experience with ITIL processes, change management, and Agile/hybrid project delivery.

· Experience with Azure Virtual Desktop or VMware Horizon.

**Key Performance Indicators**

· Reduction in critical incidents and mean time to resolve (MTTR).

· On-time, on-budget delivery of upgrade and migration projects with minimal downtime.

· Improved logon times and user experience metrics.

· POC outcomes delivered with clear, actionable recommendations.

· Quality and completeness of architecture documentation and knowledge transfer.

The Candidate will support in creation of Cyber Security as a Business model to have an impact on OI. Additionally, the candidate will be responsible for development of team and procedures so that Cyber Security as a Business becomes independent model to generate revenue.

**How You'll Make an Impact**

* The Cyber Security Specialist will create Technical and Commercial Proposal based on Customer Requirements and Regulatory demand, integrating Cyber Security into the overall Protection, Automation and Control (PAC) solution to comply with Cyber Security regulations and industry best practices, and to generate OI. The Candidate must keep his knowledge up to date to craft solutions based on latest Cyber Security trends and PAC technologies to meet the dynamic market demand.

This includes activities such as Assessments as per IEC62443 / ISO 2700 series, Vulnerability & Patch Management, Security Incident & Event Management, etc. and handling day-to-day Cyber Security needs for the Business Unit.
* The Cyber Security Specialist day-to-day be responsible for Conducting internal trainings for various teams to upgrade the Cyber Security know-how. Additionally, the candidate will be responsible for conducting trainings for customers to attract business opportunities for Siemens Energy by showcasing the capabilities and offerings.
* Supporting sales in customer discussions on cybersecurity topics, acting as a technical advisor to help the customer identify the solution that best fits their operational, technical and regulatory needs, and contributing to securing orders.
* Representing the Cyber Security capabilities in various external forums like ISA, IEEMA, CBIP, CEA and MOP to establish a connect which in turn shall generate benefit for the new business model.

* Successfully completed degree in B-Tech/B.E. or comparable training with relevant professional experience of 15-17years in the field of Operation Technology (OT) for Power System.

* The candidate must have hands-on know-how on digitalization concepts such as Digital Substation and Digital Twin, and on the protocols and mechanisms used in substation automation, including Modbus, IEC 60870-5-101/103/104, the full IEC 61850 communication stack (MMS for client-server, GOOSE for fast peer-to-peer messaging and Sampled Values for process bus), network redundancy protocols (PRP and HSR as per IEC 62439-3), time synchronization (PTP/IEEE 1588 and SNTP), and SNMP for network monitoring.

Siemens Energy India Limited (SEIL) has been a strategic partner in India for more than 100 years and is focused on being the most-valued energy technology company. title: Cyber Security Senior Analyst/Engineer
description:
**Position Summary**

The Senior Cybersecurity Engineer – Network Security will lead the design, engineering, implementation, and continuous improvement of network security controls across a globally distributed industrial manufacturing environment. The role will secure enterprise networks, cloud connectivity, remote access, and IT/OT boundaries while ensuring resilient, scalable, and compliant security architecture across regions.

**Work this position does**

* Design, implement, and maintain global network security architecture, standards, and engineering baselines.
* Administer and optimize next-generation firewalls, network segmentation, secure remote access, VPN, SASE/SSE, IDS/IPS, and related security controls.
* Strengthen IT/OT segmentation and secure connectivity to manufacturing sites, plants, data centers, and industrial systems in coordination with OT and plant engineering teams.
* Lead firewall rule reviews, access-control assessments, network security hardening, configuration reviews, and remediation of identified weaknesses.
* Support security incident response by investigating network-based threats, analyzing traffic and logs, implementing containment measures, and coordinating with the SOC and incident response teams.
* Manage network security changes, upgrades, lifecycle management, high availability, disaster recovery, and configuration backups.
* Establish global network security standards while accommodating regional regulatory requirements, data residency constraints, and operational needs.
* Evaluate new technologies, identify architectural gaps, and develop roadmaps for network security modernization.
* Collaborate with infrastructure, cloud, workplace technology, identity, vulnerability management, and third-party service providers.
* Maintain technical documentation, network security diagrams, operational procedures, audit evidence, and risk exceptions.
Provide technical inputs during complex implementations, outages, incidents, and security improvement initiatives.  

**Specific Objective of this role**

Establish and continuously improve a consistent, resilient, and risk-based network security posture across all global locations, with particular emphasis on secure IT/OT connectivity, effective network segmentation, controlled privileged and third-party access, and rapid containment of network-based threats—without disrupting critical manufacturing operations.

**Basic Educational Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, Telecommunications, Cybersecurity, or a related engineering discipline.
* 13–15 years of relevant experience in network engineering and network security, including substantial hands-on experience in enterprise-scale environments.
* Strong experience designing, implementing, troubleshooting, and operating enterprise network security solutions.
Demonstrated experience working across geographically distributed environments and coordinating with global IT and infrastructure teams.  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CCNP Security, CCIE Security or equivalent vendor certifications. Current certification names and availability should be validated during recruitment.
* Hands-on experience with next-generation firewalls, firewall policy management, IDS/IPS, VPN, secure remote access, network access control, and network segmentation.
* Experience with SASE/SSE platforms, cloud network security, zero-trust network access, and hybrid enterprise connectivity.
* Knowledge of industrial cybersecurity and OT environments, including Purdue-model concepts, industrial DMZs, secure remote vendor access, and segmentation of manufacturing networks.
* Familiarity with IEC 62443, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, NIST SP 800-82, and relevant regional regulatory requirements.
* Experience integrating network security telemetry with SIEM/SOC platforms and supporting threat detection, investigation, and incident containment.
* Experience in global manufacturing, industrial machinery, engineering, automotive, chemicals, food processing, or other environments with operationally critical sites.
* Strong troubleshooting, architecture documentation, vendor management, risk assessment, and stakeholder communication skills.
* Ability to lead technical initiatives across time zones and provide technical guidance to internal teams and service providers.

**Who we are:**

Mold-Masters ( www.moldmasters.com ) is a leading global supplier of hot runners, controllers, auxiliary injection and co-injection systems. We design, manufacture, distribute, sell and service highly engineered and customized plastic processing equipment that caters to every market. Mold-Masters is a business unit of Hillenbrand.

Hillenbrand ( www.hillenbrand.com ) is a global industrial company that provides highly engineered, mission-critical processing equipment and solutions to customers in over 100 countries around the world. Our portfolio is composed of leading industrial brands that serve large, attractive end markets, including durable plastics, food, and recycling. Guided by our Purpose — Shape What Matters For Tomorrow™ — we pursue excellence, collaboration, and innovation to consistently shape solutions that best serve our associates, customers, communities, and other stakeholders.
  
  
EEO: The policy of Hillenbrand Inc. is to extend opportunities to qualified applicants and employees on an equal basis regardless of an individual's age, race, color, sex, religion, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression or veteran status. Additionally, Hillenbrand Inc. and our operating companies are committed to being an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Employer and offers opportunities to all job seekers including individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to assist with your job search or application for employment, email us at recruitingaccommodations@hillenbrand.com . In your email, please include a description of the specific accommodation you are requesting as well as the job title and requisition number of the position for which you are applying. At Hillenbrand, everyone is welcome to apply and "Shape What Matters for Tomorrow".

title: Senior Infrastructure & Network Engineer
description:
**Company Description**

Version 1 has celebrated 30 years in business and continues to be trusted by global brands to deliver technology and transformation solutions that drive customer success. Our deep expertise enables our customers to navigate the rapidly evolving technology landscape. We foster strong partnerships with global technology leaders including Microsoft, AWS, Oracle, Red Hat, OutSystems, Snowflake, ensuring that our customers are provided with the highest quality solutions and services.

We’re an award-winning employer reflecting how our employees are at the very heart of what we do:

* UK & Ireland's premier AWS, Microsoft & Oracle partner
* 3300+ strong, €350/£300m revenue business
* 10+ years as a Great Place to Work in Ireland & UK
* Best Workplace for Women in the UK & Ireland by GPTW
* Best Workplace for Wellbeing in the UK by GPTW

We’re a core values driven company, we hire people who share our values, and we reward those who display and foster them, it’s deeply embedded within our DNA. Invest in us and we’ll invest in you!.

 **Job Description**

**Role overview**

You will own the most complex infrastructure and network issues across on-premises, AWS, Azure and hybrid environments, acting as the final technical escalation point before vendors.

Alongside operational ownership, you will play a lead engineering role in a multi-year cyber security uplift programme: rolling out Zscaler SASE (ZIA, ZPA), retiring Always-On VPN, and bringing customer remote access services in line with Zero Trust controls.

**Key responsibilities**

Senior escalation and technical leadership

* Act as the Level 3 escalation point for Level 1 and Level 2 teams, owning critical incidents, major problems and complex service requests through to resolution.
* Lead technical bridges during major incidents, coordinating engineers, vendors and stakeholders and communicating impact clearly to management.
* Mentor Level 2 engineers, review their fixes and build team capability through documented troubleshooting approaches.
* Set technical standards for network, server and cloud configuration, and review changes raised by other engineers.

 **Qualifications**

**SASE / SSE and Zero Trust (programme duties)**

* Engineer and operate the Zscaler platform: ZIA for internet and SaaS security, ZPA for private application access.
* Deploy and maintain ZPA App Connectors in AWS, including integration with AWS Transit Gateway to reach customer jump service environments.
* Lead phased migration of users from Always-On VPN to ZPA, including pilot groups, parallel running, rollback planning and final decommissioning of RRAS infrastructure.
* Integrate Zscaler with Microsoft Entra ID for authentication, user group policy and conditional access.
* Configure ZIA policy for URL filtering, SSL inspection, DLP enforcement and AI application controls, working with Security Operations on tuning and exceptions.
* Deploy and support Zscaler Zero Trust Branch and SD-WAN appliances at office sites.
* Work directly with Zscaler Professional Services and implementation partners during deployment, then take ownership of the platform as business-as-usual.
* Produce design documents, runbooks and knowledge transfer material so Level 1 and Level 2 teams can support the platform after go-live.
* Administer and troubleshoot AWS and Microsoft Azure: VPCs and VNets, Transit Gateway, routing, security groups, compute, identity and service availability.
* Support Windows Server and Linux estates, including Active Directory, patching, hardening and performance diagnosis.
* Support virtualisation, storage and backup platforms, and lead upgrades and patching through change control.
* Cloud and server infrastructure

  **Problem management and improvement**
* Lead root-cause analysis for major and repeat incidents, and track remediation actions to closure.
* Improve monitoring and alerting coverage across network, SASE and cloud layers.
* Automate repetitive tasks with PowerShell, Python or Bash, and use infrastructure-as-code where it reduces configuration drift.
* Apply security, compliance and change management processes across all environments.
* Support vulnerability remediation, Cloud Security Posture Management findings, audits and ISO 27001 evidence gathering.
* Escalate risks and service-impacting issues promptly to the Programme Director, Security Lead and management.
* Security, risk and compliance  
    
  **Role and Responsibility**
* We are looking for **8+ years in infrastructure**, networking or cloud roles within complex IT environments, including at least 3 years at senior or Level 3 escalation level.
* Hands-on SASE or SSE deployment and operational experience; Zscaler (ZIA, ZPA) strongly preferred, with Netskope, Palo Alto Prisma Access or Cloudflare One also considered.
* Hands-on configuration and troubleshooting experience with at least two of: Juniper (Junos), Fortinet FortiGate, Palo Alto Networks (PAN-OS).
* Strong networking knowledge: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, BGP, OSPF, switching, firewalls, IPsec and SSL VPN.
* Hands-on administration of both AWS and Microsoft Azure, including cloud networking (Transit Gateway, VNet peering, hybrid connectivity).
* At least one cloud certification at associate level or higher (e.g. AWS Solutions Architect Associate, Azure Administrator Associate, Azure Network Engineer Associate).
* Proven experience supporting Windows Server and Linux environments.
* Experience integrating network access with identity platforms, ideally Microsoft Entra ID.
* Track record of leading infrastructure migrations or VPN replacement projects from pilot to full rollout.
* Ability to interpret logs and packet captures and isolate faults across on-premises, cloud and SASE paths.
* Clear communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders, including vendors and customers.

  **Desirable**
* Zscaler certifications: Zscaler Digital Transformation Administrator (ZDTA) or Engineer (ZDTE).
* Vendor certifications: Palo Alto PCNSE, Fortinet FCP or FCSS (formerly NSE 4 to 7), Juniper JNCIS or JNCIP.
* Experience with SD-WAN and Zero Trust branch deployments.
* Experience with DLP, SSL inspection policy design and Microsoft Purview integration.
* Infrastructure-as-code experience (Terraform, Ansible) and scripting in PowerShell, Python or Bash.
* Interest in applying AI tools responsibly to infrastructure operations and diagnosis.
* Experience supporting customer-facing remote access or managed service environments.
* Calm and methodical under pressure, with confidence to own unfamiliar problems and drive them to resolution.

 **Additional Information**

**Why Version 1?**

At Version 1, we believe in providing our employees with a comprehensive benefits package that prioritises their wellbeing, professional growth, and financial stability.

* Share in our success with our Quarterly Performance-Related Profit Share Scheme, where employees collectively benefit from a share of our company's profits
* Strong Career Progression & mentorship coaching through our Strength in Balance & Leadership schemes with a dedicated quarterly Pathways Career Development programme
* Flexible/remote working, Version 1 is tremendously understanding of life events and people’s individual circumstances and offer flexibility to help achieve a healthy work life balance
* Financial Wellbeing initiatives including; Pension, Private Healthcare Cover, Life Assurance, Financial advice and an Employee Discount scheme
* Employee Wellbeing schemes including Gym Discounts, Bike to Work, Fitness classes, Mindfulness Workshops, Employee Assistance Programme and much more. Generous holiday allowance, enhanced maternity/paternity leave, marriage/civil partnership leave and special leave policies
* Educational assistance, incentivised certifications, and accreditations, including AWS, Microsoft, Oracle, and Red Hat
* Reward schemes including Version 1’s Annual Excellence Awards & ‘Call-Out’ platform.
* Environment, Social and Community First initiatives allow you to get involved in local fundraising and development opportunities as part of fostering our diversity, inclusion and belonging schemes.

And many more exciting benefits… drop us a note to find out more.

Version 1 is an equal opportunities employer.

We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace where everyone feels valued and able to thrive. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and lived experiences, and we value the different perspectives people bring including those shaped by disability and neurodiversity.

We want every candidate to have a positive and accessible recruitment experience. If you need reasonable adjustments at any stage of the process, please contact your recruiter at Version 1. We will consider all requests carefully, respectfully and confidentially.
