title: Software Development Senior Specialist
description:
**Req ID:** 395187
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Software Development Senior Specialist to join our team in Bengalore, Karnātaka (IN-KA), India (IN).
  
  
Senior Site Reliability AIOps Platform Engineer (Applied ML LLM)
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
As a Senior Site Reliability AIOps Platform Engineer, you will design, build, and operationalize the machine learning and data foundations that transform our enterprise infrastructure from reactive, alert-driven operations into predictive, self-healing platforms. You will operate at the intersection of distributed systems reliability, data engineering, and applied artificial intelligence - replacing operational toil and alert fatigue with topology-aware correlation, statistical anomaly detection, and agentic triage workflows. In this role, you will define the canonical telemetry models that unify operational signals across multi-cloud environments, deploy ML models that eliminate noise at enterprise scale, and lead the architecture of LLM-powered incident intelligence. You will partner with platform and infrastructure teams to accelerate Mean Time to Resolution (MTTR), enforce strict Service Level Objectives (SLOs), and scale closed-loop automation under rigorous enterprise governance.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Telemetry Foundations Canonical Operational Schemas
  

* Architect and standardize canonical data models that unify multi-source alerts, incident tickets, infrastructure topology, maintenance windows, and deployment events into a consistent operational fabric.
* Design robust ingestion pipelines and streaming connectors across heterogeneous infrastructure stacks, networks, hyper-scalers, and containerized platforms.
* Engineer automated data extraction pipelines to mine structured outcome labels (e.g., automated mitigations, recurring anomalies, human interventions) from historical operational data to train supervised models.
* Establish data contracts, quality controls, latency SLAs, and automated data-protection and masking guardrails across all operational feature stores and vector pipelines.

Applied Machine Learning Predictive Incident Intelligence
  

* Design and deploy supervised classifiers for dynamic alert noise scoring, change-risk impact forecasting, and event suppression.
* Implement unsupervised clustering, pattern mining, and graph-based topology correlation over complex dependency graphs to intercept alert cascades and multi-hop cascading failures.
* Build statistical and time-series anomaly detection models (e.g., forecasting, isolation algorithms) to identify performance degradation and drive proactive capacity planning across compute, storage, and network layers.
* Drive the end-to-end MLOps lifecycle for operations—building reproducible training workflows, validation suites, concept/data drift monitoring, and continuous retraining schedules.

Agentic Operations, LLM Tooling Contextual Enrichment
  

* Architect intelligent enrichment workflows utilizing LLMs and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to dynamically synthesize tickets with runbooks, historical incident post-mortems, and live architectural state.
* Develop agentic incident response tools leveraging standard interface protocols (e.g., Model Context Protocol / tool-calling frameworks) and multi-agent coordination to automate first-pass root-cause analysis on complex, multi-signal failures.
* Establish empirical evaluation harnesses (e.g., programmatic evals, LLM-as-Judge, deterministic regression suites) to measure model quality, hallucination risk, and accuracy before operational deployment.
* Expand closed-loop automated remediation by identifying recurring failure signatures and safely mapping them into deterministic execution engines with confidence-scored validation gates.

Cloud Platform Reliability AI Governance
  

* Embed reliability engineering principles into AI pipelines, treating ML services and agentic workflows as critical tier-0 platform components governed by SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets.
* Lead the operational rollout of AI tools through staged governance tiers (development sandbox, supervised review, human-in-the-loop validation, bounded autonomous execution).
* Drive post-incident analysis on novel outages, utilizing post-mortem telemetry to continuously refine correlation algorithms and suppression policies.

Basic Qualifications
  

* 5+ years of progressive experience in Site Reliability Engineering, Machine Learning Engineering, or Data Platform Engineering operating at enterprise scale.
* Proven track record of shipping production-grade ML models and data pipelines rather than purely experimental or research-focused workflows.
* Strong software engineering fundamentals in Python and production ML frameworks (e.g., scikit-learn, XGBoost, pandas/numpy, and modern time-series/clustering libraries).
* Deep data engineering experience: designing canonical schemas, building streaming/batch ingestion pipelines, and enforcing data hygiene across messy, high-volume telemetry sources.
* Practical understanding of core SRE principles (SLIs/SLOs, error budgets, incident lifecycle management, distributed observability).
* Strong technical communication skills with a proven ability to lead cross-functional architecture reviews across platform, operations, and security stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications
  

* Hands-on experience applying Graph ML or graph analytics to infrastructure topology, service maps, or dependency networks.
* Demonstrated experience building production LLM-assisted workflows, including tool calling, agentic orchestration frameworks, vector databases, and formal evaluation benches.
* Hands-on expertise with enterprise observability pipelines and log aggregators (e.g., OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Kafka, Vector, ClickHouse, or major cloud-native logging ecosystems).
* Familiarity with enterprise AI governance, model risk management, auditability, and data privacy requirements.
* Experience managing containerized workloads and operational pipelines on Kubernetes.

About NTT DATA
  
  
NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is a part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in RD.
  
  
Whenever possible, we hire locally to NTT DATA offices or client sites. This ensures we can provide timely and effective support tailored to each client’s needs. While many positions offer remote or hybrid work options, these arrangements are subject to change based on client requirements. For employees near an NTT DATA office or client site, in-office attendance may be required for meetings or events, depending on business needs. title: Senior Network Engineer
description:
Job Description:

**The Team**

We're a **global R&D / Innovation team** across the Middle East, Asia, and Europe, building the **next generation of software-defined automation** (SDA). We close the gap between today's automation systems and tomorrow's open, software-defined plants, turning emerging standards and technologies into solutions that matter. IT/OT convergence is at the heart of everything we build.

**The Role**

You'll join a team of automation and software engineering experts, designing, testing, validating, and troubleshooting network architectures that address **critical customer needs**. You'll also own the testing and verification lab network, ensuring it performs reliably and remains optimized. Working across **both IT and OT systems**, you'll turn bold ideas into **high-impact, real-world innovations** through hands-on engineering.

**What You'll Do**

* **Serve as the networking** **expert for global and cross-functional teams**, supporting Engineered Solutions and verification and validation activities in local and remote labs.
* **Manage the operation, maintenance, and upgrades** of multiple local and remote lab networks.
* **Design, configure, and troubleshoot Layer 2/Layer 3 networks**, including VLANs, routing, switching, redundancy, link aggregation, and network segmentation.
* **Evaluate and** **validate** new networking technologies for software-defined and OPA-based automation, and turn results into **reference architectures**.
* **Troubleshoot complex network issues using packet capture and protocol analysis**, addressing latency, packet loss, routing, MTU, interface errors, and performance issues.
* **Implement network security and resilience controls**, including firewalls, ACLs, VLAN/VRF segmentation, secure management access, redundancy, and device hardening.
* **Design and** **maintain** **lab networks** that span physical switches, hypervisors, and container hosts, including VLAN trunking into VMs and container networking.

**Must-Have**

* **Bachelor’s degree** in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Telecommunications, or a related field, with **5****+** **years of experience** in network design, testing, troubleshooting, and industrial process-control network infrastructure.
* **Strong knowledge of Layer 2/Layer 3 networking**, including TCP/IP, IP addressing, subnetting, routing, VLANs, trunking, multicast, IGMP snooping, QoS, network segmentation, and RSTP across diverse network topologies.

title: Customer Support Engineer
description:
Job Title: Customer Support Engineer

Experience: 5+ Years

Work Mode: Remote

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Full-Time

Company Overview

Nuventure Connect is an ISO 27001:2022 and SOC 2 certified technology services company that leverages deep technology expertise to solve complex business problems and empower clients worldwide. Our commitment to state-of-the-art solutions spans the entire product value chain, delivering next-generation software, end-to-end IoT solutions, cloud infrastructure management, and managed IT support services.

About the Role

The Customer Support Engineer is a customer-facing technical role, not a help-desk position. Customer service and the quality of the customer experience sit alongside technical skill as core, non-negotiable parts of the job. You will be the first technical point of contact for customers running production workloads on the GPU infrastructure: diagnosing infrastructure issues, executing approved remediation, and owning each customer's issue from first response through resolution — even when the deeper fix comes from our NOC or Engineering teams.

You will work alongside an experienced NOC / Infrastructure Operations team that handles advanced GPU fabric, storage-platform and networking issues. You do not need to know everything on day one, but you do need to know how to triage, communicate clearly with a technical customer, and escalate well. This role suits people who care about the customer on the other end of the ticket, enjoy real infrastructure, and want a clear path into NOC and engineering roles.

Key Responsibilities

Customer Ownership & Communication

* Own customer tickets end-to-end across Jira, Slack and email (or an equivalent ITSM platform): acknowledge quickly, set accurate expectations, send proactive updates, confirm resolution and close the loop
* Stay customer-facing after internal escalation — the customer keeps one accountable point of contact even when the NOC or Engineering performs the deeper troubleshooting
* Communicate clearly with engineers, researchers and infrastructure teams: explain technical issues plainly, be honest about uncertainty, and de-escalate frustrated customers with empathy and precision Infrastructure Troubleshooting
* Triage each issue to distinguish customer and application problems from infrastructure, hardware, network, storage or GPU problems
* Perform basic GPU diagnostics (nvidia-smi, ECC error review, GPU health checks) and review monitoring dashboards and alerts (Grafana / Prometheus-style tooling) as a first diagnostic step
* Perform basic Linux, networking (DNS, DHCP, VLANs, connectivity) and storage troubleshooting, including WEKA drive and status checks, within your authorized scope
* Recognize tenant-caused issues versus true infrastructure faults on shared, multi-tenant GPU infrastructure
* Gather and document evidence — logs, error messages, timelines, serial and node data — for suspected hardware faults and RMA candidates

Controlled Operations & Change

* Execute approved reboots, power cycles and re-imaging workflows through documented runbooks, with pre- and post-checks and clear communication of maintenance impact
* Validate and coordinate firmware and vBIOS update requests: confirm hardware and support status, schedule the work, document the change, and hand off to NOC or Engineering when the activity exceeds your authorization
* Follow change-control and maintenance-window procedures; never freelance production changes

Escalation, Onboarding & Continuous Improvement

* Escalate advanced GPU fabric (NVLink / NVSwitch), InfiniBand / RoCE, deep storage-platform and multi-node issues to the NOC with a complete handoff: customer impact, affected infrastructure, timeline, symptoms, logs, tests performed, results and suspected cause
* Support delegated customer onboarding tasks such as access validation, connectivity checks and environment readiness checks
* Document resolutions and flag recurring issues, runbook gaps and knowledge-base improvements

Qualification

* Strong written and verbal communication with technical audiences — you can explain an issue clearly to an engineer, set accurate expectations and communicate uncertainty honestly
* Demonstrated ownership: a track record of seeing customer or user issues through to resolution rather than handing them off at the first difficulty
* Solid Linux fundamentals (Ubuntu / RHEL): CLI, SSH, processes and services, filesystems, permissions, logs and package management
* Working knowledge of core networking: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, subnets and basic connectivity troubleshooting
* Comfort reading monitoring dashboards and alerts, and following structured runbooks
* Disciplined use of ticketing and ITSM tools (Jira Service Management, Zendesk, ServiceNow, Freshservice or similar)
* Ability to operate in a production infrastructure environment with defined change-control and escalation discipline
* Experience in technical support, NOC, data center, MSP or cloud / infrastructure support, or equivalent demonstrated troubleshooting ability
* Flexibility to support evening, weekend and holiday coverage as the team grows toward 24×7 operations

Preferred Skills

* Exposure to NVIDIA GPU tooling (nvidia-smi, CUDA basics) and ECC concepts, or a strong willingness to ramp quickly
* Experience with multi-tenant or shared infrastructure (public cloud, virtualization / hypervisor platforms, multi-tenant SaaS): tenant isolation, resource contention and noisy-neighbor issues
* Exposure to container and Kubernetes concepts (pods, namespaces, logs, resource constraints)
* Basic Python or Bash scripting for log parsing and diagnostics
* Exposure to storage concepts (filesystems, mounts, block / file / object) or platforms such as WEKA, VAST or Pure Storage
* Prior experience at a GPU cloud, hyperscaler, MSP or AI infrastructure provider
* Desired certifications (not required): CompTIA Linux+ or Network+, RHCSA, ITIL 4 Foundation, cloud provider certifications
* Understanding of compliance operations in SOC 2 or ISO 27001 environments

Key Skills & Expertise

* Linux: RHEL / Ubuntu
* NVIDIA GPU: nvidia-smi / ECC
* GPU Monitoring: DCGM / GPU Health Checks
* Networking: TCP/IP · DNS · DHCP · VLANs
* Storage: Storage Fundamentals / WEKA
* Monitoring: Grafana / Prometheus
* ITSM: Jira Service Management / ITSM
* Incident Response: PagerDuty / Alert Response
* Containers: Kubernetes / Container Basics
* Scripting: Python / Bash — Light Scripting
* Infrastructure: Multi-Tenant / Shared Infrastructure
* Documentation: Runbook & KB Authoring
* Change Management: Change Control & Maintenance Windows
* Communication: Written Customer Communication
* Incident Handling: Escalation & Evidence Gathering

title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**About the Role:**  
We are seeking a talented and experienced Senior Infrastructure Engineer specializing in Operating Systems (OS), large‑scale Virtualization, Azure Cloud, Observability, and Automation to join Maersk. You will be responsible for designing, building, and operating complex, high‑performance, highly available infrastructure platforms, with a strong focus on automation, performance, and reliability. The ideal candidate will have substantial experience with VMWare, Nutanix, DC components like compute, storage, and network, Java/JVM, Docker/Kubernetes, alongside strong coding and scripting skills. Knowledge of networking, AIOps, and workload/data centre migration will be an added advantage.

As an Infrastructure Engineer, you will demonstrate the following characteristics:

* Proven background in delivering complex, high‑performance, highly available solutions at scale.
* Creativity in coming up with innovative approaches to projects and to any issues that arise.
* A strong bias for action – you are a “do’er” who gets things done.
* Passion for sharing expertise and insight with other engineers and teams.

Currently the tech stack is not 100% fixed, but we have a strong preference for commercial experience of open‑source plus cloud technologies. The ideal candidate will have a background that spans development, architecture, and operations. We are looking for full‑stack‑minded engineers with deep expertise in three primary areas and working knowledge across all:

* **Virtualization** – AHV, VMware
* **DevOps** – GitHub, Terraform, Ansible
* **Backend / Platform** – Python, CLI, RESTful APIs, CI/CD pipelines, process orchestration

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Infrastructure and Virtualization Engineering:**

* Design, build, and operate virtualization environments and remote DC using technologies such as VMware vCenter and Nutanix.
* Support and manage both on‑prem and cloud‑hosted virtualization platforms, ensuring high availability, performance, and capacity alignment with business needs.
* Drive data centre and workload migrations using industry‑standard tools and methodologies.
* Manage and optimize data storage, server resources, and other virtual computing platforms.

**Cloud, Automation and DevOps:**

* Engineer and optimize Azure and other public cloud infrastructure (Google / Azure) for scalability, performance, resilience, and cost‑efficiency.
* Design, enhance, and support automation tools and pipelines (GitHub, Terraform, Ansible, CI/CD) that drive consistency, repeatability, and team efficiency.
* Develop and maintain automation scripts and tools using Python, Bash, PowerShell, and RESTful APIs for provisioning, configuration management, and operational tasks.
* Apply Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and DevOps practices to standardize environments and reduce manual work.

title: Warehouse Logistics Specialist
description:
**About Nebius:**

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

**The role**  
  
The Warehouse Specialist runs day-to-day warehouse operations at a Nebius data center site. The role receives, stores and issues high-value hardware (GPU racks, servers, network equipment, spare parts), keeps stock and asset records accurate, and provides equipment to data center engineers on time.  
  
The specialist is the site's hands-on link to the wider logistics function: Transportation and Transport Coordination for arrivals and pickups, Logistics Planning and 3PL Planning for schedules, Back Office for system records, and the Project Office for new processes and tools.  
  
**Your responsibilities will include:**  
  
1. Receiving & Dispatch

* Receive inbound shipments per the delivery schedule; check seals, packaging and contents against ASN, packing list and PO.
* Record damage and discrepancies with photos on arrival and hand them to Transport Coordination for insurance cases.
* Prepare outbound shipments and RMA returns: picking, packing, labelling, documents; hand over to carriers at the agreed pickup time.
* Follow handling standards for heavy, fragile and high-value equipment.

2. Provisioning to Data Center Operations

* Issue equipment and spare parts to DC engineers on time, according to requests and project priorities.
* Stage and kit hardware for rack deployments as agreed with ITDC and Project Managers.
* Keep a clear view of what is available on site and flag shortages to the Team Lead and Logistics Planning.

3. Inventory & Asset Control

* Post receipts, issues and transfers in ERP/WMS on the same day as the physical movement.
* Create inventory and asset records for received equipment, including serial numbers.
* Carry out cycle counts and annual stock takes; investigate and report discrepancies to Back Office.
* Keep the warehouse tidy, labelled and organised by location.

4. Security, Safety & Compliance

* Follow site security procedures for deliveries, access control and storage of high-value items.
* Apply safety rules for handling equipment and operating material handling equipment.
* Keep records complete and audit-ready (SOX, internal and external audits).

5. Process & Continuous Improvement

* Work according to global SOPs and site-specific instructions.
* Suggest improvements and report recurring issues to the Team Lead and the Project Office.
* Take part in pilots and rollouts of new processes and tools (WMS/TMS, automations) at the site.

6. Local Expertise

* Provide site-specific knowledge (access rules, dock limits, local carriers and customs specifics) to Transport, Planning and 3PL teams.
* Identify local operational risks and propose practical mitigation.

7. Add-on Roles (when assigned)

* + RMA: own RMA flows at the site — intake, documentation, return shipment, status tracking.
* + Key User (IRG / NetSuite / Project44): first-line support and training for colleagues on the system, test changes, collect feedback for the Project Office.

**We expect you to have:**

* Autonomy: Independently runs daily warehouse tasks at the site within SOPs; escalates discrepancies, damage and security issues to the Team Lead.
* Impact: Keeps DC engineers supplied with the right hardware on time and keeps site stock accurate.
* Communication: Clear, timely updates to the Team Lead, DC engineers and logistics teams.
* Travel: Occasional support to other sites during launches or peaks.
* Work Mode: On site; remote work not expected.
  

**Benefits & Perks:**

* Competitive compensation
* Career growth and learning opportunities
* Flexibility and ownership
* Collaborative and innovative culture
* Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
* International environment and talented teams

**What's it like to work at Nebius:**

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

**Equal Opportunity Statement:**

Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

title: RF Design Engineer
description:
**About Harpy Aerospace**

Harpy Aerospace is building the future of accessible space technology by developing innovative satellite systems, remote-sensing platforms, and scientific payloads. As we expand our satellite communications and payload capabilities, we are seeking a passionate and detail-oriented **RF Design Engineer** to strengthen our core engineering team.

**Role Overview**

As an **RF Design Engineer** at Harpy Aerospace, you will lead the design, simulation, and testing of RF subsystems for nanosatellites, including antennas, transceivers, and telemetry systems. You will collaborate closely with systems, mechanical, and mission operations teams to develop robust space-qualified RF solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and optimize RF circuits: LNAs, mixers, filters, impedance networks, and power amplifiers
* Develop and simulate antenna systems for CubeSats (UHF/VHF/S/L bands) using CST/HFSS
* Perform link budget analysis for ground-space communication (TT&C and payload data)
* Ensure compliance with IARU, ITU, and WPC regulations for frequency coordination
* Support SDR integration, beacon systems, and custom transceivers
* Create test plans and conduct functional RF testing with VNA, spectrum analyzer, and signal generators
* Collaborate with mechanical and PCB layout engineers to ensure EMC/EMI compatibility and flight readiness
* Document test results, prepare design reviews, and support mission operations post-deployment

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s/Master’s degree / PhD in Electronics, Telecommunications, Avionics or RF/Microwave Engineering
* Minimum 1–4 years hands-on experience in RF subsystem design and prototyping
* Proficiency with RF simulation tools (e.g., Keysight ADS, CST, Ansys HFSS)
* Experience with amateur satellite communications, modulations (2FSK/BPSK), and space mission protocols
* Strong foundation in PCB design for RF layouts and test validation

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience with CubeSat or small satellite programs
* Familiarity with TI CC1110, or other space-rated RF modules
* Understanding of satellite link budgeting, Doppler shift handling, and in-orbit RF diagnostics
* Knowledge of ECSS or ISRO quality standards for spaceflight hardware

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to work on cutting-edge nanosatellite missions from concept to orbit
* A collaborative, hands-on R&D environment with direct impact on mission success
* Competitive compensation with performance-based incentives
* Mentorship and growth alongside senior engineers and space scientists
* A chance to contribute to India's new space revolution

**To Apply:**

Email your resume and a short cover letter to **team@harpyaerospace.in** with the subject line:  
**“RF Design Engineer Application – [Your Full Name]”**

Job Types: Full-time, Contractual / Temporary

Pay: ₹9,682.26 - ₹31,840.81 per month

Benefits:

* Leave encashment

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Network Engineer II
description:
**Company Description**

At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.

 **Job Description**

We are looking for an experienced network engineering leader to help drive the design, modernization, support, and evolution of Nielsen’s enterprise network environment in India. This role is not limited to end-user experience. It is a broad technical lead role spanning network architecture, core infrastructure modernization, VPN transformation, network segmentation, security controls, operational stability, and cross-functional delivery.

You will serve as a technical lead across both project and operational domains, partnering with network engineering, NOC, cybersecurity, cloud/platform teams, application owners, local IT, and support teams to deliver secure, scalable, and resilient network services. This person should be equally comfortable working in product-oriented environments that prioritize speed and roadmap execution, and in support-oriented organizations that require operational rigor, incident response, stability, and service excellence.

**Role overview**

This position will lead technical direction across enterprise networking initiatives, with a strong focus on architecture, modernization, and execution. The successful candidate will help evolve legacy environments into well-governed, enterprise-grade network platforms while also supporting ongoing production operations and mentoring engineers across the team.

**Key responsibilities**

* Lead network architecture and modernization initiatives across campus, branch, datacenter, internet edge, remote access, and hybrid cloud connectivity environments.
* Act as the technical lead for VPN strategy and transformation, including modernization of remote access models, alignment with next-generation firewall capabilities, and improvements to secure user and site connectivity.
* Drive network segmentation initiatives to improve security posture, limit lateral movement, and establish risk-based trust zones and access controls without disrupting business operations.
* Partner with cybersecurity, application teams, server owners, and change management teams to design, test, and implement network changes in a controlled and pragmatic manner.
* Provide technical leadership across routing, switching, DNS, DHCP, wireless, firewalling, authentication, and access control domains.
* Support the evolution of enterprise and cloud networking patterns, including hybrid connectivity, governance, scalability, and performance optimization.
* Act as a senior escalation point for complex network incidents, chronic issues, and cross-functional troubleshooting involving support, operations, and engineering teams.
* Create and maintain network diagrams, traffic flow maps, standards, SOPs, and implementation documentation.
* Use traffic analysis, telemetry, firewall logs, and network data sources to identify bottlenecks, reduce risk, and improve performance and reliability.
* Mentor other engineers, influence technical direction, and help establish best practices that balance product agility with enterprise reliability and governance.

 **Qualifications**

* 12+ years of hands-on experience in network engineering, network architecture, and production support in medium to large enterprise environments.
* Proven experience operating as a technical lead or senior engineer across both project delivery and business-as-usual support models.
* Prior experience working in both product-oriented organizations and support/service-oriented organizations.
* Strong background in core networking, including routing, switching, DNS, DHCP, and enterprise wireless.
* Strong experience with VPN technologies, remote access architecture, firewall policy design, and network security controls.
* Experience leading or materially contributing to network segmentation, access control, and zero trust or trust-zone initiatives.
* Excellent troubleshooting skills and the ability to lead high-severity issue resolution across multiple teams.
* Experience with authentication and network access technologies such as 802.1x, NAC, RADIUS, and EAP-TLS.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts, present risks, negotiate change windows, and align diverse teams.

**Preferred qualifications**

* Experience with Cisco, Meraki, Palo Alto, and/or Fortinet platforms.
* Experience with SD-WAN, SASE, ZTNA, and modern remote access patterns.
* Experience with cloud networking and hybrid connectivity across AWS and other public cloud platforms.
* Familiarity with automation or infrastructure-as-code approaches for network consistency, governance, and scale.
* Experience in traffic analysis, network visualization, and phased deployment planning.

**What success looks like**

* You provide clear technical leadership across architecture, modernization, and operational support.
* You improve the security and resilience of the network through better segmentation, access design, and lifecycle governance.
* You help modernize VPN and remote connectivity patterns while maintaining a strong user and operational experience.

**Profile summary**

We are seeking a seasoned network engineering leader who combines deep technical expertise with operational judgment and strong collaboration skills. You should be comfortable leading change, supporting critical production environments, and shaping network architecture that is secure, modern, scalable, and practical to operate day to day.

* You bridge product velocity and support stability, ensuring network services scale with business needs.
* You raise the technical maturity of the team through mentorship, documentation, standards, and execution discipline.

 **Additional Information**

Please be aware that job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

title: Sr Network Engineer
description:
Fluence (Nasdaq: FLNC) is a global market leader delivering intelligent energy storage and optimization software for renewables and storage. Our solutions and operational services are helping to create a more resilient grid and unlock the full potential of renewable portfolios. With gigawatts of successful implementations across nearly 50 markets, we are transforming the way we power our world for a more sustainable future. For more information, please visit fluenceenergy.com .

**Job Description:**

**Role Overview**
-----------------

  

The Senior Network Engineer is responsible for designing, implementing, maintaining, and troubleshooting secure and reliable network infrastructure for utility-scale Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) and Operational Technology (OT) environments.

This role focuses on network architecture, industrial networking, firewall configuration, network segmentation, and connectivity across Fluence Energy Storage products. The engineer will collaborate with cross-functional engineering, cybersecurity, deployment, and product development teams to ensure network reliability, scalability, security, and compliance with industry standards.

  

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Design, configure, and maintain network infrastructure supporting utility-scale BESS and OT environments.
* Develop and implement network architectures involving routers, switches, firewalls, VLANs, VPNs, and industrial communication networks.
* Configure and troubleshoot Cisco, Palo Alto, and other enterprise networking technologies.
* Implement network segmentation, firewall policies, access control lists (ACLs), and secure remote connectivity.
* Support network integration between industrial controllers, SCADA systems, RTACs, gateways, and Fluence software platforms.
* Troubleshoot complex network issues involving routing, switching, DNS, DHCP, NTP, TCP/IP, and communication protocols.
* Support industrial communication protocols, including Modbus TCP, OPC UA, MQTT, and BACnet.
* Collaborate with cybersecurity teams to implement network security controls aligned with IEC 62443 and OT cybersecurity best practices.
* Develop and maintain network architecture diagrams, configuration standards, deployment procedures, and technical documentation.
* Support network testing, validation, commissioning, and troubleshooting across development, laboratory, and customer environments.
* Participate in network automation initiatives using Ansible, Python, or similar technologies.
Work with cross-functional teams to identify network risks, improve reliability, and standardize network configurations across Fluence products.  

  

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field.
* 5–8+ years of hands-on experience in network engineering, infrastructure, or industrial networking.
* Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, routing, switching, VLANs, VPNs, NAT, DNS, DHCP, and NTP.
* Hands-on experience configuring and troubleshooting Cisco switches, routers, and Palo Alto firewalls.
* Experience with network segmentation, firewall policies, and secure remote access solutions.
* Strong troubleshooting skills using tools such as Wireshark, tcpdump, traceroute, and other network diagnostic utilities.
* Working knowledge of Linux networking, particularly Ubuntu-based environments.
* Experience developing network diagrams, technical documentation, and configuration standards.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
Ability to collaborate effectively with geographically distributed engineering and product development teams.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience working in Operational Technology (OT), Industrial Control Systems (ICS), energy storage, renewable energy, or power generation environments.
* Knowledge of industrial protocols such as Modbus TCP, OPC UA, MQTT, and BACnet.
* Familiarity with IEC 62443, NERC CIP, and industrial cybersecurity practices.
* Experience with network automation using Ansible, Python, or infrastructure-as-code tools.
* Knowledge of virtualization technologies, including VMware ESXi and virtual networking.
* Experience with network monitoring tools such as Zabbix, PRTG, or similar platforms.
* Familiarity with high-availability network architectures, redundancy, and industrial network reliability.
Professional certifications such as CCNP, CCNA, PCNSE, or equivalent.  

  

**Key Competencies**
--------------------

* Network Architecture and Design
* Routing, Switching, and Firewall Management
* OT/ICS Network Security
* Industrial Communication Protocols
* Linux Networking and Troubleshooting
* Network Automation and Standardization
* Cross-Functional Collaboration
* Technical Documentation and Problem-Solving

title: Technical Support Specialist I
description:
Overview:

The L1 Technical Support Specialist provides front-line remote and telephonic technical assistance for critical security screening equipment, including baggage X-ray systems and trace detection products (e.g., ETD/BPI/RTT systems). This role focuses on basic L1 troubleshooting, customer/Field Engineer guidance, accurate part number identification using technical documentation, and efficient issue escalation to ensure maximum security checkpoint uptime.

Responsibilities:

* **Level 1 Technical Support & Basic Troubleshooting**

* Provide initial diagnostic and troubleshooting assistance over the phone and via remote access tools for baggage X-ray systems and Trace detection equipment.
* Diagnose basic hardware, software, power, and mechanical issues, Password issues including:
* + **X-Ray Systems:** Conveyor belt jams, basic software crashes, power supply issues, image display artifacts, and operator interface errors.
  + **Trace Detection Products:** Basic sample inlet/calibrator errors, clearing standard system alarms, flow rate/gas line issues, and basic sensor/detector warnings.
* Guide operators and Field Service Engineers (FSEs) through basic resolution steps, such as performing power cycles, running system self-tests, verifying cable connections, adjusting basic image settings, and clearing basic system jams.
* **Part Identification & Schematic Lookup**

* Analyze technical manuals, exploded-view diagrams, schematics, and Bill of Materials (BOM) to accurately identify correct replacement part numbers for X-ray and Trace product lines.
* Assist field personnel and customers with part identification to prevent order errors and minimize equipment downtime.
* **Escalation & Documentation**

* Log and track all incoming incidents in the ticketing system (CRM), maintaining clear records of symptoms, basic steps taken, and diagnostic results.
* Recognize when an issue exceeds L1 scope (e.g., complex generator failure, trace spectrometer calibration issues, deep network integration) and escalate promptly as per escalation matrix with complete case details.
* **Customer Service & Compliance**

* Deliver clear, concise instructions to both technical (FSEs) and non-technical (checkpoint operators, airport security) personnel under high-pressure security environments.
* Stay current on technical product updates, service bulletins, and basic regulatory requirements for checkpoint screening.

**Technical Skills:**

* **Product Familiarity:** Basic understanding of X-ray imaging components (conveyors, generators, detectors) and Trace Detection technologies (ETD).
* **Part Lookup:** Demonstrated ability to read technical diagrams, assembly drawings, and schematics to isolate correct part numbers.
* **Systems & Networking:** Solid grasp of basic computer hardware, OS navigation, remote access tools, and fundamental networking concepts (IP addressing, connectivity).

**Soft Skills:**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with a strong customer-first orientation.
* Strong active listening skills to de-escalate urgent situations in critical operational environments.
* High organizational skills and ability to manage multiple open support tickets effectively.

**Working Conditions**

* This is a 5-day working role with 2 rotational offs.
* Must be comfortable working in rotational shifts to support global operations.
* Preference will be given to candidates who can align their schedules to cover key business hours in time zones like GMT and PST.

Qualifications:

* **Education:** Associate degree or vocational certification in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent technical experience.
* **Experience:** 3-4+ years of experience in technical support, helpdesk, or field service—preferably supporting security screening, medical imaging, or trace detection systems.

title: Software Development Engineer II, Relay Yard Automation, Relay Yard Automation
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon moves millions of packages daily through a global logistics network of Fulfillment Centers, Sort Centers, and Delivery Stations. Every facility has a trailer yard — the physical space where line-haul vehicles arrive, get loaded or unloaded, and depart. Tracking what's happening in these yards in real time (which trailers are where, what state they're in, who's arriving and departing) is a hard problem that sits at the intersection of physical operations and software systems.  
  
The Relay Yard Automation (RYA) team builds the software that manages these trailer yards across 6,000+ Amazon facilities on three continents. Our products handle 200K+ gate transactions  
per day and facilitated the arrival and departure of 55M vehicles last year. We integrate computer vision, RFID, GPS, ultrasonic sensors, and IoT edge devices to automate what were historically manual, associate-staffed processes, from gate check-in/check-out to in-yard trailer movements. Our gate automation program has already eliminated millions of manual transactions, with a long-term goal of fully autonomous yard operations.  
  
The tech stack is diverse by necessity: Android mobile apps for yard associates and drivers, React web applications for remote gate agents and yard operators, Java/TypeScript backend services on AWS, and hardware integrations running on edge compute devices deployed in the field. Systems are loosely coupled, event-driven, and must operate reliably in environments ranging from 1M+ sq ft North American fulfillment centers to small urban European delivery stations.  
  
As an SDE on this team, you will design and build features and services that power yard automation across Amazon's logistics network. You will write high-quality code across the full stack, contribute to system design discussions, and deliver projects from technical design through production launch. The role involves working across backend services, web and mobile applications, and integrations with physical sensor systems at the edge. You will make thoughtful engineering trade-offs, participate in design and code reviews, and contribute to the team's operational excellence practices — supporting tier-1 systems where your work directly impacts driver experience and Amazon's ability to meet customer delivery promises.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Design and implement software for yard and gate automation products across tier-1 systems. Your code runs in production where defects directly impact driver experience and customer delivery promises.

  

* Lead large projects end-to-end: define the technical approach in ambiguous problem spaces, decompose work into parallel workstreams, and deliver cohesive launches.

  

* Own system architecture for your team's services. Proactively simplify code, resolve architecture deficiencies, and remove bottlenecks across Java backend services, TypeScript/React web apps, Android mobile apps, and IoT edge devices.

  

* Make short-term vs. long-term trade-off decisions and communicate them clearly to your team and stakeholders.

  

* Integrate with physical systems — RFID readers, computer vision cameras, ultrasonic sensors, GPS — running on edge compute in variable warehouse environments. Debug problems that span hardware and cloud software.

  

* Own operational excellence for services you build: monitoring, alarming, runbooks, incident response, and root-cause corrective actions.

  

* Influence technical direction beyond your team through design reviews with partner teams across Transportation Technology.

  

* Act as a force multiplier. Raise the engineering bar through code reviews, design artifacts, and reusable frameworks. Mentor junior engineers toward their next level.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* 3+ years of Video Games Industry (supporting title Development, Release, or Live Ops) experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: NetScaler Engineer
description:
**Position Summary**
--------------------

The NetScaler Engineer owns the design, operation, and security of the Citrix NetScaler (formerly Citrix ADC) environment, with a primary focus on the NetScaler Gateway (Citrix Access Gateway) platform that gives employees and partners secure remote access to Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops.

The role keeps remote access available, fast, and secure; resolves complex connectivity and authentication issues; and leads upgrades, patching, and improvements across the gateway estate.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Citrix Access Gateway Support (Primary Focus)**
-------------------------------------------------

* Administer, configure, and maintain NetScaler Gateway virtual servers for ICA proxy access to Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops and Citrix Workspace.
* Integrate gateways with StoreFront and/or Citrix Cloud (Workspace), including session policies, profiles, callback URLs, and Secure Ticket Authority (STA) configuration.
* Build and support authentication flows using nFactor, LDAP/LDAPS, RADIUS, SAML, and multi-factor authentication providers such as Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, Duo, or RSA.
* Configure and troubleshoot Endpoint Analysis (EPA) scans, SmartAccess and SmartControl policies, and client certificate authentication.
* Serve as the escalation point for remote access incidents, including login failures, STA errors, session drops, HDX/EDT performance, and reconnect problems.
* Support HDX optimization through the gateway, including EDT (UDP/DTLS), Session Reliability, and audio/video for Microsoft Teams and softphone traffic.

**NetScaler Platform Operations**
---------------------------------

* Manage NetScaler BLX, CPX, VPX, MPX, and/or SDX appliances in high-availability pairs and clusters, including GSLB across data centers.
* Plan and execute firmware upgrades and emergency security patching, tracking vendor security bulletins and CVEs and applying fixes within defined SLAs.
* Manage SSL/TLS certificates, cipher groups, and SSL profiles; track renewals to prevent certificate-related gateway outages.
* Configure load balancing, content switching, responder, and rewrite policies for StoreFront, Director, and other internal services.
* Use NetScaler Console (formerly ADM), logs, and packet traces such as nstrace and Wireshark for monitoring, analytics, and root-cause analysis.
* Automate configuration and routine tasks with the NITRO API, PowerShell, Python, or Ansible/Terraform where practical.
* Migrate NetScalers from VMware ESXi clusters to Oracle OCI clusters.

**Security, Change Management & Documentation**
-----------------------------------------------

* Harden gateway configurations against current security baselines and support vulnerability scans, penetration tests, and audits.
* Follow change-management processes for all production changes, including test plans, rollback steps, and post-change validation.
* Maintain current architecture diagrams, runbooks, configuration standards, and disaster recovery procedures.
* Work with Citrix/VDI, Active Directory, identity, firewall, network, and service desk teams, and with vendor support on escalated cases.

 **Requirements**

* 5+ years of Hands-on experience deploying and troubleshooting NetScaler Gateway for Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops (XenApp/XenDesktop) and StoreFront.
* Strong understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, SSL/TLS, PKI, HTTP, and load-balancing concepts.
* Experience with directory and identity integration, including Active Directory, LDAP, RADIUS, SAML, and MFA providers.
* Proficiency with packet-capture analysis and structured troubleshooting of authentication and connectivity issues.
* Experience with high-availability pair operations, firmware upgrades, and certificate lifecycle management.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical issues to non-technical users.
* Ability to overlap 5 hours with US Central time zone hours

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Current NetScaler or Citrix networking certification, such as Citrix Certified Associate or Professional – Networking.
* Understanding of virtualization platforms such as VMware ESXi and Oracle OCI
* Experience with Citrix Cloud, Gateway Service, Cloud Connectors, and hybrid Citrix deployments.
* Experience with NetScaler Console (ADM), GSLB, and Web App Firewall (WAF).
* Scripting and automation experience with the NITRO API, PowerShell, Python, Ansible, or Terraform.
* Exposure to Zero Trust or ZTNA alternatives, such as Citrix Secure Private Access, and cloud platforms such as Azure or AWS.
* Experience in a regulated environment, such as healthcare (HIPAA) or finance.

title: Lead Solutions Architect
description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

**The Team:**

Every Celonis outcome starts with data. As a Solutions Architect, you make sure our customers' data gets into the Celonis Platform reliably, securely, and at scale, and that insights and actions flow back out into the systems and AI tools where work actually happens.

**The Role:**

  

In this role you will work across diverse enterprise source systems such as SAP, Salesforce, and cloud databases, with a strong focus on the Oracle technology ecosystem. You will drive data extraction from Oracle environments (Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, Oracle E-Business Suite, Oracle Database and Autonomous Database) and build integrations with Oracle's AI and automation infrastructure.

You will own complex, highly customized integration projects end to end, anticipate blockers before they surface, and shape the best long-term solution together with the customer and Celonis internal teams. You are a trusted technical advisor to customer IT, data, and security leaders, and a go-to partner for colleagues across Services, Product & Engineering, and Go-to-Market.

Beyond day-to-day delivery, you invest part of your time in growing the SA practice: building reusable assets, and driving small initiatives that advance team strategy, including our Oracle integration playbooks.

**The work you'll do:**

**Lead complex data integration and ingestion**

* Own Oracle data extraction. Architect and deliver ingestion from Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, Oracle EBS R12, and Oracle Database / Autonomous Database, including JDBC and PL/SQL-based approaches, while understanding the underlying business processes in these systems.
* Build real-time and CDC integrations. Design change data capture and event-driven architectures using Oracle GoldenGate, Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), Kafka, and REST/SOAP APIs, and use them to power Celonis Action Flows.
* Deliver Oracle ERP and other enterprise connections. Lead Oracle ERP connections or cloud based equivalents (e.g. via Oracle BICC). Deliver customized JDBC setups, including Dockerized and real-time configurations.
* Build and own custom API connectors. Design advanced connectors, including complex authentication, pagination, and delta loads, and advise on API design topics such as synchronous versus asynchronous APIs and OData.
* Architect push-based and lakehouse pipelines. Lead Python-based pipelines with Celonis data ingestion API with data engineering and SDLC best practices, and design Landing Zone and lakehouse solutions (for example Databricks, or Microsoft Fabric), including zero copy solutions.
* Solve hard infrastructure problems. Work with customer IT on DMZs, network bridges, WAFs, proxies, certificates, on-premise agent deployments, and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) networking.

* Be a recognized expert. Build deep expertise in Oracle integrations and other product areas, give structured feedback to Product & Engineering on Oracle connectors and AI agent capabilities, and become a source of trust for product managers and engineers.
* Advance team strategy. Set up and run initiatives such as knowledge bases and best-practice libraries (for example Oracle integration templates): define goals and success criteria, document the plan, and hold yourself and others accountable.

**The qualifications you need:**

* 8+ years of experience in data engineering, technical consulting, or solutions architecture in a customer-facing role, including leading customer implementations.
* Oracle data engineering experience:hands-on experience extracting data from and understanding business processes in Oracle systems (Fusion Cloud ERP, Oracle EBS R12, Oracle Database / Autonomous Database), with PL/SQL and Oracle SQL skills.
* Oracle Cloud: experience with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) and its integration and data services such as Oracle Integration Cloud, alongside familiarity with AWS, Azure, or GCP is a plus.
* Python and SQL skills, and ETL pipeline creation for large volumes of enterprise data, including migration scripting and custom transformations.
* Hands-on experience with REST/SOAP APIs, authentication patterns, and API design concepts (synchronous and asynchronous APIs, OData).
* Network and security fluency at the level needed to engage customer enterprise IT (DMZ, WAF, proxies, certificates, VPNs), plus comfort with Linux environments.
* Excellent communication and storytelling across written, verbal, and slide formats, tailored to technical and executive audiences, and fluency in English.
* A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with Oracle Exadata, Oracle Select AI (Database 23ai), Oracle Digital Assistant, or Oracle Analytics.
* Familiarity with SAP (ECC/S/4HANA, PI/PO, SNC, RISE, CPI, BTP) or other enterprise ERPs.
* Experience with Snowflake, Databricks, or Microsoft Fabric, and with iPaaS or low-code tools (MuleSoft, Boomi, Workato, Power Automate).
* Experience with LLMs, AI agents, or MCP.
* Docker and Linux server administration experience.
* Relevant certifications (Celonis, Oracle/OCI, cloud, or SAP).

**What Celonis can offer you:**

* Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
* Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
* Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
* Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
* Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
* Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.
* Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
* Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
* Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

**About Us:**

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.

title: Service Operations Engineer
description:
**About Providence**
--------------------

Providence, one of the US’s largest not-for-profit healthcare systems, is committed to high quality, compassionate healthcare for all. Driven by the belief that health is a human right and the vision, ‘Health for a better world’, Providence and its 121,000 caregivers strive to provide everyone access to affordable quality care and services.

Providence has a network of 51 hospitals, 1,000+ care clinics, senior services, supportive housing, and other health and educational services in the US.

Providence India is bringing to fruition the transformational shift of the healthcare ecosystem to Health 2.0. The India center will have focused efforts around healthcare technology and innovation, and play a vital role in driving digital transformation of health systems for improved patient outcomes and experiences, caregiver efficiency, and running the business of Providence at scale.

  

**Why Us?**
-----------

* Best In-class Benefits
* Inclusive Leadership
* Reimagining Healthcare
* Competitive Pay
* Supportive Reporting Relation

About the Role

We are looking for a highly skilled and customer-focused Support Engineer to join our team. The support engineer is responsible for handling advanced support issues, resolving and triaging escalated technical problems. This role requires strong troubleshooting capabilities, excellent communication, and a deep understanding of IT infrastructure and end-user technologies

Our Team culture

* Work environment, which is collaborative and driven by learning, attention to details & empathy towards our caregivers
* Empowering & enabling individuals and teams to realize their full potential
* Focus on outcomes, solving our caregivers’ pain points & predictable delivery
* Data driven decision making on vision & roadmap of the Service Desk

What will you be responsible for

  

The ideal candidate will have a blend of technical, process & operational skills in service desk management, operations, customer interactions and call handling. The candidate should be skilled at applying her/ his experience with a focus on problem solving, supporting systems, operational excellence, service quality, reduction of manual toil with focus on End User experience. Candidate should be highly collaborative and has good working experience in Global operating setups.

Key Responsibilities

* **Customer Service**: Personal responsibility for customer satisfaction. Professionally represents the ‘Face and Voice of IT’ in difficult situations, consistently strives to listen, understand, and support the needs of others in a sensitive manner.
* **Quality**: Performs challenging tasks efficiently and effectively. Anticipates problems and takes corrective action prior to completing the task. Sets challenging objectives and works against self-defined standards of excellence to continually improve personal performance.
* **Problem Solving**: Strong attention to detail and outstanding analytical skills.
* Collaboration: Ability to work effectively to build relationships with colleagues, customers, and management through positive interaction.
* **Flexibility and response to change**: Proven ability to organize multiple efforts and to respond to shifting priorities. Demonstrated ability to study, understand, adapt, and respond effectively to a constantly changing environment.
* **Communications**: Listens with sensitivity and openness. Actively seeks constructive feedback and remains open and receptive to it. Anticipates the information needs of others. Proven skills in communicating with clinical and technical customers.
  

What would your day look like?

* Handle incidents and service requests escalated from Tier 1 support via ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow)
* Troubleshoot and resolve hardware, software, and network issues for end users.
* Provide support for Windows/Mac OS, Microsoft 365, VPN, printers, mobile devices, and collaboration tools.
* Identify area of opportunity for latest Knowledge Articles towards enhanced FCR (First Call Resolution) and supportability.
* Ensure production solutions are reliable, secure, and effective and that implemented solutions are continuously monitored and documented. Look for opportunities to Left Shift and Right Shift tickets to reduce overall customer pain points, manual toil, and cost per ticket.
* Execute operational excellence, tracking metrics and KPIs to drive governance, quality, and efficiency. Influence and improve existing processes through innovative behaviors and effective change management.
* Perform Data Quality Audit on Incident logging. Suggest required changes towards deriving incident patterns and trends.
* Perform monthly Incident Pattern and Theme analysis.
* Execute opportunities and drive automation to improve KPIs on ticket reduction, ticket cycle time and resolution rate.
* Perform administrative tasks and troubleshooting in the following environments including Citrix, Active Directory, Single Sign-On services, E-mail Exchange, Patient electronic health records and other applications as needed.
* Support Active Directory tasks: password resets, user account management, group policy troubleshooting.
* Manage remote access and connectivity issues (e.g., Citrix, VPN, RDP).
* Escalate unresolved incidents to Tier 2 or specialized teams with detailed documentation.
* Follow ITIL best practices for incident, problem, and change management.

Who are we looking for?

* 1-3 years of Industry experience in Service Management, Service Operations, IT Service Desk Operations
* Good Communications skills (Fluent English)
* Flexibility to work in 24\*7 work environment
* ITIL v4/v5 Foundation certification (Preferred)
* Required Skills: M365, Basic Network overview, Power BI, SQL
* Experience with Active Directory and ITSM tools

title: Network Architect
description:
Candescent is a forward-thinking technology company transforming how financial institutions deliver Intelligent Banking experiences. We unite digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions that power and connect digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions—creating seamless engagement across digital, remote, and in-person channels.

Our Experience-Led, Intelligence-Driven approach combines human-centered design with data, automation, and cloud-based innovation. Built on an API-first architecture, our extensible ecosystem enables institutions to adapt quickly, integrate easily, and unlock new opportunities for growth—turning every customer interaction into a moment of clarity, confidence, and connection.

**Position Summary**

Candescent is seeking an experienced and innovative **Network Architect** to lead the design, strategy, and evolution of our enterprise network infrastructure. This role is responsible for developing scalable, secure, and resilient network architectures that support corporate offices, cloud environments, financial institution operations, and emerging business initiatives.

The Network Architect will partner closely with Infrastructure, Security, Cloud Engineering, Application Development, and Operations teams to define technology roadmaps, establish engineering standards, and drive modernization initiatives. This position serves as the highest level of technical authority for enterprise networking and provides guidance for complex projects, strategic investments, and operational excellence.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Enterprise Network Architecture**

* Develop and maintain the enterprise network architecture roadmap.
* Design highly available, scalable, and secure LAN, WAN, WLAN, SD-WAN, Cloud and B2B Networking and internet edge solutions.
* Create and maintain high-level and low-level network designs, standards, and reference architectures.
* Evaluate existing environments and recommend improvements aligned with business objectives.
* Establish networking standards and governance for all Candescent locations and hosted environments.

**Cloud & Hybrid Networking**

* Design connectivity solutions for Azure, AWS,GCP (Must Have) and hybrid cloud deployments.
* Define architectures for cloud transit networking, DNS, routing, security segmentation, and application delivery.
* Lead cloud networking initiatives on secure multi-cloud connectivity.
* Collaborate with cloud engineering teams on network automation and infrastructure-as-code initiatives.

**Security Architecture & Compliance**

* Partner with Information Security teams to design secure network solutions.
* Develop architectures supporting Zero Trust, network segmentation, NAC, SASE, ZTNA, and secure remote access.
* Ensure designs meet regulatory and compliance requirements including FFIEC, PCI-DSS, SOX, and corporate security standards.
* Provide technical leadership during security assessments, audits, and risk reviews.

**Strategic Leadership**

* Provide architectural oversight for major infrastructure projects.
* Lead technology evaluations, proof-of-concepts, and vendor assessments.
* Develop multi-year network technology roadmaps and lifecycle management strategies.
* Influence infrastructure direction through innovation and industry best practices.
* Present architectural recommendations to senior leadership and executive stakeholders.

**Operational Excellence**

* Act as the highest escalation point for complex networking issues.
* Review network performance, capacity, resiliency, and availability metrics.
* Guide disaster recovery and business continuity planning efforts.
* Ensure infrastructure designs align with operational supportability requirements.

**Automation & Modernization**

* Promote network automation and orchestration strategies.
* Design solutions utilizing APIs, scripting, and infrastructure-as-code platforms.
* Drive adoption of modern operational models and observability platforms.
* Partner with engineering teams to implement automated provisioning and configuration management.

**Mentorship & Collaboration**

* Mentor Network Engineers and Senior Engineers on architecture and design principles.
* Participate in technical reviews, change advisory boards, and project governance.
* Foster technical excellence across Infrastructure Engineering teams.
* Build strong partnerships with business units, application owners, vendors, and managed service providers.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related discipline.
* 10+ years of enterprise networking experience.
* 5+ years designing large-scale, mission-critical network environments.
* Expert level experience with:
  + GCP Networking
  + Cloud and B2B Networking
  + Palo Alto Networks firewalls
  + Meraki Wireless networking technologies
  + SD-WAN solutions
* Strong experience designing:
  + Fortigate Network firewalls
  + Corporate office networks
  + Hybrid cloud connectivity
  + Individual Financial Institution Networks
* Experience with network security architecture and segmentation strategies.
* Proven ability to lead large-scale infrastructure transformation projects.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Financial services or regulated industry experience.
* Experience with:
  + Cisco Wireless / Meraki
  + Palo Alto Networks & SCM
  + Azure networking
  + AWS networking
  + GCP networking (Must Have)
  + Prisma Access
  + Network automation platforms
* Knowledge of infrastructure-as-code frameworks.
* Experience with monitoring and observability platforms.

title: Cyber Security & Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a proactive Cyber Security & Infrastructure Engineer with 1.5 years or more of relevant experience in IT infrastructure, cybersecurity operations, network security, system administration, and security monitoring. The candidate will help maintain a secure and reliable technology environment by implementing security controls, monitoring infrastructure, managing vulnerabilities, and supporting applicable regulatory and audit requirements.

**Key ResponsibilitiesCybersecurity Operations**

* Monitor security alerts, system logs, and suspicious activities to identify potential threats.
* Support vulnerability assessments, penetration testing coordination, and remediation tracking.
* Help protect sensitive customer information, personally identifiable information (PII), and financial data.
* Support endpoint protection (antivirus/EDR), firewall, and intrusion detection/prevention controls.
* Assist with security incident investigation, documentation, escalation, and root cause analysis.
* Support Data Loss Prevention (DLP) controls to reduce unauthorized data sharing or transfers.

**IT Infrastructure & Network Security**

* Administer and monitor servers, operating systems, network devices, and cloud infrastructure.
* Support firewall rules, VPNs, access controls, network segmentation, and secure remote access.
* Perform system hardening, security patching, and operating system updates.
* Monitor infrastructure availability, performance, backups, and security configurations.
* Support cloud security and identity/access management in platforms such as Oracle Cloud, AWS, or Azure.
* Assist with backup, disaster recovery (DR), and business continuity (BCP) activities.

**Identity & Access Management**

* Manage user access provisioning, modification, and deactivation based on approved requests.
* Support role-based access control (RBAC), least privilege, and multi-factor authentication (MFA).
* Conduct periodic access reviews and identify inactive, excessive, or privileged access.

**Security Compliance & Audit**

* Support cybersecurity and IT control requirements applicable to an RBI-regulated NBFC.
* Assist with internal/external audits, VAPT, evidence collection, and audit response.
* Maintain asset inventories, access review records, patch reports, incident logs, and security documentation.
* Track audit observations and coordinate timely remediation with relevant teams and vendors.

**Monitoring, Reporting & Incident Response**

* Monitor events using available SIEM, EDR, firewall, and infrastructure monitoring tools.
* Escalate critical security incidents and infrastructure issues promptly.
* Prepare periodic reports on vulnerabilities, patch compliance, access reviews, security alerts, and infrastructure health.
* Coordinate with development, infrastructure, and third-party vendor teams to resolve security issues.

**Required Technical Skills**

* **Networking:** TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, VPNs, routing, and firewall fundamentals.
* **Operating Systems:** Windows Server and Linux administration.
* **Security Tools:** Exposure to firewalls, antivirus/EDR, vulnerability scanners, and SIEM platforms.
* **Infrastructure:** Server administration, patch management, backup solutions, and basic cloud security.
* **Security Fundamentals:** Vulnerability management, system hardening, access control, incident response, and log analysis.
* **Cloud Platforms:** Basic knowledge of Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), AWS, or Microsoft Azure.
* **Scripting:** Basic Python, PowerShell, or Bash scripting is an advantage.
* **Documentation:** Ability to maintain technical documentation, security reports, and audit evidence.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
* Minimum 1.5 years of relevant experience in cybersecurity, IT infrastructure, network administration, or information security operations.
* Certifications such as CompTIA Security+, CCNA, Microsoft Security, or cloud security certifications are preferred, not mandatory.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Understanding of confidentiality and secure handling of customer information.
* Ability to coordinate with internal teams, auditors, and external technology vendors.
* Proactive approach to identifying and resolving security risks.
* Good communication, documentation, and incident reporting skills.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Timely identification, tracking, and remediation of vulnerabilities.
* Security patch compliance across servers and endpoints.
* Timely closure of security audit observations.
* Completion of access reviews and appropriate privileged account controls.
* Timely detection, escalation, and documentation of security incidents.
* Monitoring of backup jobs and participation in recovery tests.
* Adherence to approved security policies and infrastructure hardening standards.

**Note:** The role supports the organization’s cybersecurity and infrastructure controls in line with applicable regulatory requirements, internal policies, and the organization’s risk profile.

description:

--------------------
